a: I allibba derabbi eliezer kaamar, afillu lechattechilla name.
Ella, la kashya: ha — rabbi shimon, ha — rabbanan, detanya: ben levi shennifseka lo nima bechinnor — koshrah, rabbi shimon omer: onvah.
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: af hi enah mashmaat et hakkol. ella meshalshel millematta vechorech millemala, o meshalshel millemala vechorech millematta.
Veibbaet ema: ha veha rabbanan, vela kashya: kan baemtza, kan min hatztzad.
Veibbaet ema: ha veha baemtza, mar savar: gazrinan, umar savar: la gazrinan.
Mishna chotchin yabbelet bammikdash, aval lo bimdina. veim bichli — kan vechan asur.
Gemara ureminhu: herkevo, vahavaato michutz lattechum, vachatichat yabbalto — en dochin, rabbi eliezer omer: dochin!
Rabbi elazar verabbi yose (ben) chanina, chad amar: ha veha belacha, vela kashya: kan — bayyad, kan — bichli.
Vechad amar: ha veha bayyad, vela kashya: ha — belacha, ha — bivesha.
Uleman deamar "ha bayyad ha bichli", may tama la amar "ha belacha ha bivesha"? amar lach: yevesha — afillu bichli name shere, may tama? ipparoche ipparcha.
Uleman deamar "ha belacha veha bivesha", may tama la amar "ha bayyad ha bichli"? amar lach: bichli — ha tenan: im bichli — kan vechan asur.
Veiddach — ha dekatane hatam, mishshum deka bae ippeloge rabbi eliezer verabbanan.
Veiddach — dumeya deherkevo vahavaato michutz lattechum katane, derabbanan.
Veiddach: herkevo dela kerabbi natan, deamar: hachay nose et atzmo. havaato michutz lattechum kerabbi akiva, deamar: techumin deorayyta.
Metiv rav yosef: amar rabbi eliezer, kal vachomer: uma shechita shehi mishshum melacha — docha et hashshabbat, ellu, shemmishshum shevut — eno din sheyyidchu et hashshabbat?
Ella amar rav yosef: ha veha bayyad, ushevut mikdash bammikdash — hittiru, shevut demikdash bammedina — lo hittiru.

Yetev abbaye vekaamar leha shemata. etiveh rav safra leabbaye: haya kore bassefer al haiskuppa, venitgalgel hassefer miyyado — gollo etzlo. veha hacha dishvut demikdash bammedina hu, vela gazrinan dilma nafel veate leetoye!
Vela okemna beiskuppa karmelit ureshut harabbim overet lefaneha, dechevan deigdo beyado — afillu shevut name lekka?!
Etiveh: meshalshelin et happesach letannur im chashecha. veha hacha dishvut demikdash bammedina, vela gazrinan shemma yechatte baggechalim!
Ishtik. ki ata lekammeh derav yosef, amar leh: hachi amar li rav safra. amar leh: may tama la teshanne leh: bene chavura zerizin hen.
Veabbaye: "kohanim zerizin hen" — amrinan, "bene chavura zerizin hen" — la amrinan.
Rava amar: rabbi eliezer hi, deamar machshire mitzva dochin et hashshabbat. umode rabbi eliezer dechamma deefshar leshannoye meshanninan.
b: May hi, detanya: kohen shealta bo yabbelet — chavero chotchah lo beshinnav. beshinnav — in, bichli — la. chavero — in, ihu — la.
Manni? illema rabbanan uvammikdash, kevan deamri rabbanan bealma mishshum shevut — hacha, ma li hu ma li chavero?
Ella lav, rabbi eliezer deamar bealma chayyayv chattat, vehacha af al gav demachshire mitzva dochin et hashshabbat, kamma deefshar leshannoye meshanninan.
La: leolam rabbanan, vei alta bichreso — hachi name.
Hacha bemay askinan? kegon shealta lo neshicha begabbo uveatztzile yadav, deihu la matze shakel la.
Vei rabbanan, nishkeleh nihaleh beyad, vetifshot derabbi elazar: deamar rabbi elazar machaloket bayyad, aval bichli — divre hakkol chayyayv!
Velitamaych, lerabbi eliezer name lishkeleh nihaleh beyad! hay may? i amrat bishlama rabbi eliezer — hayeynu degazar yad attu keli. ella i amrat rabbanan hi — nishkeleh nihaleh beyad, vetu la midde.
Mishna kohen shellaka beetzbao — korech aleha gemi. bammikdash, aval lo bammedina. im lehotzi dam — kan vechan asur.
Gemara amar rav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay: lo shanu ella gemi, aval tziltzol katan — have yittur begadim.
Verabbi yochanan amar: lo amru yittur begadim ella bimkom begadim, aval shello bimkom begadim — la have yittur begadim.
Vetippok leh mishshum chatzitza! bismol.
I name beyamin — veshello bimkom avoda.
Ufeliga derava, deamar rava amar rav chisda: bimkom begadim — afillu nima achat chotzetzet. shello bimkom begadim, shalosh al shalosh — chotztzot, pachot mishshalosh al shalosh — enan chotztzot.
Adderabbi yochanan vadday peliga. adderav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay mi nema peliga?
Shane tziltzol katan dachashiv.
Lishshana acharina, amri la: amar rav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay: lo shanu ella gemi, aval tziltzol katan — chotzetz.
Verabbi yochanan amar: lo amru chatzitza befachot mishshalosh al shalosh ella bimkom begadim, aval shello bimkom begadim

a: Shalosh al shalosh — chotztzot, pachot mishshalosh — en chotztzot, vehayeynu derava amar rav chisda.
Lema peliga derav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay? shane tziltzol katan dachashiv.
Ulerabbi yochanan: addeashmeinan gemi layshmeinan tziltzol katan!
Milleta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan, degemi masse.
Mishna bozkin melach al gabbe kevesh bishvil shello yachliku, umemallein mibbor haggola umibbor haggadol baggalgal bashshabbat, umibbeer hakkar beyom tov.

Gemara rame leh rav ika mippashruneya lerava, tenan: bozkin melach al gabbe hakkevesh bishvil shello yachaliku. bammikdash — in, bammedina — la. ureminhi: chatzer shennitkalkela bememe geshamim — mevi teven umeradde bah!
Shane teven, dela mevattel leh.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: hay melach hechi dame? i dimvatteleh — ka mosef abbinyan (uchetiv: "hakkol bichtav miyyad Adonai alay hiskil").
Vei dela ka mevatteleh, ka havya chatzitza.
Beholachat evarim lakkevesh, delav avoda hi.
Vela? veha ketiv: "vehikriv hakkohen et hakkol vehiktir hammizbecha", veamar mar: zo holachat evarim lakkevesh! ella ema: beholachat etzim lammaaracha, delav avoda hi.
Daresh rava: chatzer shennitkalkela bememe geshamim — mevi teven umeradde bah. amar leh rav pappa lerava, vehatanya: keshehu meradde — eno meradde lo besal velo bekuppa, ella beshule kuppa!
Hadar okem rava amora aleh uderash: devarim sheamarti lifnechem taut hen beyadi, beram kach amru mishshum rabbi eliezer: ucheshehu meradde — eno meradde lo besal velo bekuppa, ella beshule kuppa.
Memallein mibbor haggola. ulla ikkela leve rav menashshe, ata hahu gavra teraf abbava amar: man hay? littachal gufeh, deka machel leh leshabbeta.
Amar leh rabba: lo asru ella kol shel shir. etiveh abbaye: maalin bidyofi umattifin meerek lachole bashshabbat.
Lachole in, labbari la. hechi dame? lav denayem veka bae delittear. shema minna: olode kala asir!
La: detir, veka bae delenim — demishtammea ki kala dezimzume.
Etiveh: hameshammer perotav mippene haofot, udeluav mippene hachayya — meshammer kedarko beshabbat, uvilvad shello yispok velo yetappeach velo yerakked kederech shehen osin bachol.
May tama — lav dekamoled kala, vechol olode kala asir? amar rav acha bar yaakov: gezera shemma yittol tzeror.
Veella ha deamar rav yehuda amar rav: nashim hamesachakot beegozim — asur. may tama — lav deka moled kala, vechol olode kala asir?
La, dilma ate leashvoye gummot.
Dei la tema hachi, ha deamar rav yehuda: nashim mesachakot betappuchim — asur, hatam may olode kala ikka?! ella: dilma ate leashvoye gummot.
Tenan: memallein mibbor haggola umibbor haggadol baggalgal beshabbat, bemikdash — in, bimdina — la. may tama, lav mishshum deolode kala — vaasir?
La, gezera shemma yemalle leginnato ulechurebato.
Ammemar shera lemimle begilgela bemachoza, amar: may tama gezaru rabbanan — shemma yemalle leginnato ulechurebato? hacha, la ginna ikka, vela chureba ikka.
Kevan deka chaze deka
b: Taru ba kittana — asar lehu.
Umibbeer hakkar. may beer hakkar? amar shemuel: bor shehikru aleha devarim vehittiruha.
Metivi: lo kol habborot hakkarot hittiru, ella zo bilvad. vei amrat "shehikru devarim aleha", may "zo bilvad"?
Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: beer mayim chayyim, shenneemar: "kehakir bayir memeha vegomer".
Gufa: lo kol habborot hakkarot hittiru, ella zo bilvad. ucheshealu bene haggola chanu aleha, uneviim shebbenehen hittiru lahen. velo neviim shebbenehen, ella minhag avotam bidehem.
Mishna sheretz shennimtza bammikdash — kohen motzio behemyayno, shello lishhot et hattumea, divre rabbi yochanan ben beroka. rabbi yehuda omer: bitzvat shel etz, shello lerabbot et hattumea.
Mehechan motziin oto — min hahechol, umin haulam, umibben haulam velammizbeach, divre rabbi shimon ben nannas.
Rabbi akiva omer: kol makom shechayyayvin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat — mishsham motziin oto. ushear kol hammekomot — kofin alav pesachter.
Rabbi shimon omer: makom shehittiru lecha chachamim, mishshellecha natnu lach — shello hittiru lecha ella mishshum shevut.

Gemara amar rav tavi bar kisna amar shemuel: hammachnis teme sheretz lammikdash — chayyayv, sheretz atzmo — patur. may tama? amar kera: "mizzachar vead nekeva teshallechu", mi sheyyesh lo tohora bemikve. yatza sheretz sheen lo tohora.
Lema mesayyay leh: "mizzachar ad nekeva teshallechu" — perat lichli cheres, divre rabbi yose haggelili. may tama, lav mishshum delet leh tohora bemikve?
La, mi shennaasa av hattumea. yatza keli cheres, sheeno naasa av hattumea.

Lema ketannae: sheretz shennimtza bammikdash — kohen motzio behemyayno, shello leshahot et hattumea, divre rabbi yochanan ben beroka. rabbi yehuda omer: bitzvat shel etz motzio, shello lerabbot et hattumea.
May lav, beha ka mippalgi: deman deamar shello leshahot, kasavar: hammachnis sheretz lammikdash — chayyayv. uman deamar shello lerabbot, kasavar: hammachnis sheretz lammikdash — patur.
La, dechulle alma chayyayv. vehacha beha ka mippalgi, mar savar: shahoye tumea — adif. umar savar: apposhe tumea — adif.
Ella kehane tannae, ditnan: mehechan motziin oto kulei.
May lav, beha ka mippalgi: deman deamar meazara la, kasavar: hammachnis sheretz lammikdash — patur, uman deamar mikkulla azara, kasavar — chayyayv.

a: Amar rabbi yochanan, ushenehem mikra echad darshu: "vayyavou hakkohanim lifnima vet Adonai letaher vayyotziu et kol hattumea asher matzu behechal Adonai lachatzar bet Adonai vaykabbelu haleviyyim lehotzi lenachal kidron chutza".
Mar savar: middeishtanni baazara bilviyyim, tumea baazara lekka.
Umar savar: ad hecha dela efshar bilviyyim, mappeki kohanim. hasheta deefshar bilviyyim, tu la mittammei kohanim.

Tanu rabbanan: hakkol nichnasin bahechol livnot letakken ulehotzi et hattumea, umitzva bechohanim. im en sham kohanim — nichnasin leviyyim, en sham leviyyim — nichnasin yisreelim. veidde veidde, tehorin — in, temein — la.

Amar rav huna: rav kahana mesayyay kahane, detane rav kahana: mittoch shenneemar "ach el happarochet lo yavo", yachol lo yehu kohanim baale mumin nichnasin ben haulam velammizbeach laasot rikkue fachim —
Talmud lomar "ach" — chillek: mitzva bitmimim, en sham temimim — nichnasin baale mumin. mitzva bithorin, en sham tehorin — nichnasin temein. idde veidde, kohanim — in, yisreelim — la.
Ibbaya lehu: tame uvaal mum, ezo mehen nichnas? rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: tame nichnas, deha ishteri baavodat tzibbur. rabbi elazar omer: baal mum nichnas, deha ishteri baachilat kadashim.

Rabbi shimon omer vechulei. rabbi shimon hecha kae? hatam kae, ditnan: mi shehecheshich chutz lattechum, afillu amma achat lo yikkanes. rabbi shimon omer: afillu chamesh esre amma yikkanes, lefi sheen hammashochot mematztzein et hammiddot mippene hattoim.
Dekaamar tanna kamma lo yikkanes, vaamar leh rabbi shimon yikkanes.
Shello hittiru lach ella mishshum shevut. hecha kae? hatam kae, dekaamar tanna kamma — koshrah. vaamar leh rabbi shimon — onvah.
Aniva, dela ate lide chiyyuv chattat — sharu leh rabbanan. keshira, deate lide chiyyuv chattat — la sharu leh rabbanan.
Haderan alach hammotze tefillin uselika lah massechet eruvin

Mishna or learbaa asar bodkin et hechametz leor hanner. kol makom sheen machnisin bo chametz, en tzarich bedika. uvamma amru "shete shurot bammartef" — makom shemmachnisin bo chametz. bet shammay omrim: shete shurot al pene kol hammartef, uvet hillel omrim: shete shurot hachitzonot shehen haelyonot.
Gemara may "or"? rav huna amar: naghe, verav yehuda amar: lele. ka salka datach deman deamar naghe — naghe mammash, uman deamar lele — lele mammash.

Metivi: "habboker or vehaanashim shullechu" — alma "or" yemama hu! mi ketiv "haor boker"? "habboker or" ketiv, keman deamar: tzafra nehar, vechidrav yehuda amar rav. deamar rav yehuda amar rav: leolam yikkanes adam bechi tov, veyetze bechi tov.
Metivi: "ucheor boker yizrach shamesh" — alma "or" yemama hu! mi ketiv "or boker"? "ucheor boker" ketiv, vehachi kaamar: ucheor boker baolam hazze, keen zerichat shemesh latztzaddikim laolam habba.

Metivi: "vayyikra elohim laor yom" — alma "or" yemama hu! hachi kaamar: lammeir uva kerao yom. ella meatta, "velachoshech kara layla" — lammachshich uva kara layla?! veha kayyma lan dead tzet hakkochavim yemama hu!
Ella, hachi kaamar: karyeh rachamana linhora ufakkedeh ammitzveta dimama, vekaryeh rachamana lachashocha ufakkedeh ammitzveta delela.

Metivi: "haleluhu kol kochve or" — alma "or" ureta hu. hachi kaamar: haleluhu kol kochavim hammeirim. ella meatta, kochavim hammeirim hu devau shabboche, sheenan meirin la bau shabboche?! veha ketiv: "haleluhu kol tzevaav"!
Ella ha ka mashma lan — deor dechochavim name or hu. lemay nafka minna? lenoder min haor. (ditnan:) hannoder min haor — asur beoran shel kochavim.
Metivi: "laor yakum rotzeach yiktol ani veevyon uvallayla yehi chaggannav",
b: Ha middekaamar "uvallayla yehi chaggannav" — alma "or" yemama hu! hatam hachi kaamar: i peshita lach milleta kinhora deannefashot kaate — rotzeach hu, venittan lehatztzilo benafsho. vei mesappeka lach milleta kelelya — yehi beenecha kegannav, velo nittan lehatztzilo benafsho.

Metivi: "yechshechu kochve nishpo yekav leor vaayin veal yire beafappe shachar", middekaamar "yekav leor vaayin" alma "or" yemama hu! hatam melat hu deka layet leh iyyov lemazzaleh, amar: yehe raava delitzpeh hach gavra linhora, vela layshkecheh.

Metivi: "vaomar ach choshech yeshufeni velayla or baadeni", alma "or" yemama hu! hatam, hachi kaamar david: ani amarti ach choshech yeshufeni laolam habba shehu dome leyom, achshav, haolam hazze shehu dome lelayla — or baadeni.
Metivi, rabbi yehuda omer: bodkin or (learbaa) asar uvearbaa asar shacharit uvishat habbiur. middekaamar rabbi yehuda: bodkin or arbaa asar uvearbaa asar shacharit, alma "or" ureta hu. shema minna.
Metivi: meematay arbaa asar asur baasiyyayt melacha? rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: mishsheat haor, rabbi yehuda omer: mishsheat hanetz hachamma.

Amar leh rabbi eliezer ben yaakov lerabbi yehuda: vechi hechan matzinu yom shemmiktzato asur baasiyyayt melacha umiktzato muttar baasiyyayt melacha? amar leh: hu atzmo yochiach, shemmiktzato muttar baachilat chametz umiktzato asur baachilat chametz.
Middekaamar rabbi yehuda mishsheat hanetz hachamma, alma "or" dekaamar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov — ureta hu! la, may "or" — ammud hashshachar.
I hachi, dekaamar leh: hechan matzinu yom shemmiktzato muttar baasiyyayt melacha umiktzato asur baasiyyayt melacha, nema ihu lenafsheh: ha ikka layla, deka share rabbi eliezer ben yaakov!

Hachi kaamar: bishlama ledidi, ashkachna deka palgi rabbanan ben yemama lelelya. (ditnan) gabbe taanit tzibbur: ad matay ochel veshote — ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar, divre rabbi eliezer ben yaakov. rabbi shimon omer: ad kerot haggever. ella ledidach, hecha ashkachna yemama gufeh defalgi beh rabbanan!

Amar leh: hu atzmo yochiach, shemmiktzato muttar baachilat chametz umiktzato asur baachilat chametz. shappir kaamar leh rabbi yehuda lerabbi eliezer? hachi kaamar leh rabbi eliezer: amena lach ana melacha derabbanan veat amrat li chametz deorayyta?! dead hacha asar rachamana, vead hacha shera rachamana.
Veiddach? shaot derabbanan.
Veiddach? harechaka hu daavud rabbanan lidorayyta.
Metivi: en massiin massuot ella al hachodesh shennira bizmanno, lekaddesho. veematay massiin massuot — leor ibburo. alma "or" ureta hu! shema minna.
Metivi: haya omed kol hallayla umakriv al hammizbeach, laora taun kiddush yadayim veraglayim, divre rabbi. "ora" shane.
Metivi mar zutera:

a: Hammappelet or lishmonim veechad, bet shammay potrin mikkorban, uvet hillel mechayyeyvim.

Amru (lahen) bet hillel levet shammay: may shena or shemonim veechad miyyom shemonim veechad? im shivva lo letumea — lo yishve lo lekorban? middekaamar bet hillel levet shammay: may shena or shemonim veechad miyyom shemonim veechad, shema minna "or" ureta hu! shema minna.
Metivi: yachol yehe neechol or lashshelishi, vedin hu: zevachim neechalim leyom echad, ushelamim neechalim lishne yamim. ma lehallan — layla achar hayyom, af kan — layla achar hayyom!
Talmud lomar: "beyom zivchachem yeachel umimmochorat vehannotar ad yom" — beod yom hu neechol, veeno neechol leor shelishi.
Yachol yissaref miyyad, vedin hu: zevachim neechalin leyom velayla echad, ushelamim neechalin lishne yamim velayla echad, ma lehallan — techef laachila serefa, af kan — techef laachila serefa.

Talmud lomar: "vehannotar mibbesar hazzevach bayyom hashshelishi baesh yissaref" — bayyom atta (soref), vei atta sorfo ballayla. middekaamar "yehe neechol or lashshelishi" — alma "or" ureta hu! shema minna.

Ta shema: or shel yom hakkippurim, mitpallel sheva umitvadde. shacharit, mitpallel sheva umitvadde. bemusaf, mitpallel sheva umitvadde. bemincha, mitpallel sheva umitvadde. bearvit, mitpallel meen shemona asar. rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer mishshum avotav: mitpallel shemona asar shelemot, mippene shetztzarich lomar havedala bechonen haddaat. alma "or" ureta hu! shema minna.
Ta shema, detane deve shemuel: lele arbaa asar bodkin et hechametz leor hanner. alma "or" ureta hu.
Ella: ben rav huna uven rav yehuda dechulle alma "or" ureta hu, vela peligi, mar ki atreh umar ki atreh. beatreh derav huna karu "naghe", uveatreh derav yehuda karu "lele".

Vetanna didan may tama la katane "lele"? lishshana mealleya hu denaket. vechidrabbi yehoshua ben levi. deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: leolam al yotzi adam davar megunne mippiv, shehare ikkem hakkatuv shemone otiyyot, velo hotzi davar megunne mippiv. shenneemar: "min habbehema hattehora umin habbehema asher enenna tehora".

Rav pappa amar: tesha, shenneemar: "ki yihye vecha ish asher lo yihye tahor mikkere layla". ravina amar: eser, vav detahor". rav acha bar yaakov amar: shesh esre, shenneemar: "ki amar mikre hu bilti tahor hu ki lo tahor".
Tanya deve rabbi yishmael: leolam yesapper adam belashon nekiyya, shehare bazzav kerao "merkav", uvaishsha kerao "moshav". veomer: "vetivchar leshon arumim". veomer: "vedaat sefatay barur millelu".

May "veomer"? vechi tema: hane mille bidorayyta, aval bidrabbanan la — ta shema: veomer "vetivchar leshon arumim". vechi tema: hane mille bidrabbanan, aval bemille dealma la — veomer "vedaat sefatay barur millelu".

Uveishsha la ketiv bah "merkav"?! vehachtiv: "vattakom rivka venaaroteha vattirkavna al haggemallim"! hatam, mishshum biatuta digmallim — orcha hi. vehachtiv: "vayyikkach moshe et ishto veet banav vayyarkivem al hachamor"! hatam,
b: Mishshum banav — orcha hu.

Vehachtiv: "vehi rochevet al hachamor"! hatam, mishshum biatuta delelya — orcha hu. veibbaet ema: mishshum biatuta delelya — lekka, mishshum biatuta dedavid — ikka. veibbaet ema: biatuta dedavid — name lekka, mishshum biatuta dehar — ikka.

Uveorayyta mi la ketiv "tame"? ella: kol hecha dechi hadade ninhu — mishtae belashon nekiyya, kol hecha dinfishin mille — mishtae belashon ketzara. kidamar rav huna amar rav, veamri la, amar rav huna amar rav mishshum rabbi meir: leolam yishne adam letalmido derech ketzara.
Vechol hecha dechi hadade ninhu mishtae bilshon kavod? veha "rochevet" veyoshevet" dechi hadade ninhu, vekaamar "rochevet"! "rochevet" ketiv.
Hanhu tere talmide dahavo yatvi kammeh derav. chad amar: shavvitinnan hay shemata kedavar acher mesannekan, vechad amar: shavvitinnan hay shemata kigdi mesannekan, vela ishtai rav bahade dehaych.

Hanhu tere talmide dahavo yatvi kammeh dehillel, vechad minnayyhu rabban yochanan ben zakkay. veamri la, kammeh derabbi, vechad minnayyhu rabbi yochanan. chad amar: mippene ma botzrin betohora veen moskin betohora? vechad amar: mippene ma botzrin betohora umoskin betumea? amar: muvetach ani baze shemmore horaa beyisrael. velo haya yamim muatim ad shehora horaa beyisrael.
Hanhu telata chahane. chad amar lehu: higgiani kefol, vechad amar: higgiani kezayit, vechad amar: higgiani kiznav halletaa. badku acharav, umatzu bo shemetz pesul.
Veha (tanya): en bodkin min hammizbeach ulemala!
La tema "shemetz pesul", ella ema "shachatz pesul". vei baet ema: shane hatam, deihu deara nafsheh.
Hahu armaa dahava salek veachel pesachim birushalayim. amar: ketiv "kol ben nechar lo yochal bo", "kol arel lo yochal bo", vaana ha kaachelna mishufere shufere.
Amar leh rabbi yehuda ben betera: mi ka safu lach mealya? amar leh: la. ki salkat lehatam ema lehu: sefo li mealya. ki selek, amar lehu: mealya sefo li! amaru leh: alya legavoah salka.

Amaru leh: man amar lach hachi? amar lehu: rabbi yehuda ben betira. amaru: may hay dekamman? bedaku batreh, veashkechuhu dearmaa hu vekatluhu. shelachu leh lerabbi yehuda ben betira: shelam lach rabbi yehuda ben betira! deat bintzivin umetzudatcha perusa birushalayim.

Rav kahana chalash. shadderu rabbanan lerabbi yehoshua bereh derav idi, amaru leh: zil bedok may dineh. ata, ashkecheh denach nafsheh. kareh lilvusheh, veahdereh lekireh laachoreh, uvache veate. amaru leh: nach nafsheh? amar lehu: ana la kaamena. "umotzi dibba hu chesil".

Yochanan chakokaa nefak lekiryayta. ki ata, amaru leh: chittin naasu yafot? amar lahem: seorim naasu yafot. amaru leh: tze uvasser lassusim velachamorim, dichtiv: "hasseorim vehatteven lassusim velarachesh". may have leh lememar? eshtakad naasu chittin yafot. i name: adashim naasu yafot.

a: Rav, bar achu derabbi chiyyay uvar achateh. ki selek lehatam, amar leh: ayyvu kayyaym? amar leh: imma kayyemet?! amar leh: imma kayyemet? amar leh: ayyvu kayyaym?!

Amar leh leshammaeh: chalotz li minalay veholech kelay achare levet hammerchatz. shema minna telat. shema minna: avel asur binilat hassandal. ushema minna: shemua rechoka enah noheget ella yom echad. ushema minna: miktzat hayyom kechullo.
Hahu deamar: dunu dini. amri: shema minna middan kaate, dichtiv: "dan yadin ammo keachad shivte yisrael".
Hahu dahava ka azel veamar: akkef yamma asesni birata. bedaku veashkechuhu demizzevulun kaate, dichtiv: "zevulun lechof yammim yishkon".
Vehasheta dekayyma lan dilchulle alma "or" ureta hu, mikkede ben lerabbi yehuda uven lerabbi meir — chametz eno asur ella mishshesh shaot ulemala, venivdok beshet.

Vechi tema zerizin makdimin lemitzvot, nivdok mitztzafra. dichtiv: "uvayyom hashshemini yimmol besar arlato", vetanya: kol hayyom kullo kasher lemila, ella shezzerizin makdimim lemitzvot, shenneemar: "vayyashkem avraham babboker".
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: beshaa shebbene adam metzuyin bevattehem, veor hanner yafe livdika.
Amar abbaye: hilkach, hay tzureba merabbanan la liftach beiddaneh beureta ditlesar denaghe arbesar — dilma mashcha leh shemateh, veate leimmenoe mimmitzva.

Beo minneh merav nachman bar yitzchak: hammaskir bayit lachavero bearbaa asar, al mi livdok? al hammaskir livdok — dachamira dideh hu, o dilma al hassocher livdok — deissura birshuteh kae? ta shema: hammaskir bayit lachavero — al hassocher laasot lo mezuza!

Hatam, ha amar rav mesharsheya: mezuza chovat haddar hi. hacha, may? amar lehu rav nachman bar yitzchak, tenena: hammaskir bayit lachavero, im ad shello masar lo maftechot chal arbaa asar — al hammaskir livdok, veim mishshemmasar lo maftechot chal arbaa asar — al hassocher livdok.
Beo minneh merav nachman bar yitzchak: hammaskir bayit lachavero bearbaa asar, chezkato baduk o en chezkato baduk? lemay nafka minna? lishayyeyleh! deleteh lehay dilshayyoleh. leatroche lehay, may?
Amar lehu rav nachman bar yitzchak, tenetuha: hakkol neemanim al biur chametz, afillu nashim afillu avadim afillu ketannim. may tama mehemne,
b: Lav mishshum dechezkato baduk, dekasavar: hakkol chaverim hem etzel bedikat chametz. detanya: chaver shemmet vehinniach megura melea perot, afillu hen bene yoman — hare hen bechezkat metukkanim.
Umimmay? dilma shane hacha, mishshum dekaamri hane. attu amira dehane midde meshasha it beh?
Ella may — dechazkato baduk? hay "hakkol neemanim", "kol habbattim bechezkat bedukin bearbaa asar" mibbee leh!
Ella may — mishshum amira dehane, ha la amri hane — la? tifshot minneh deen chezkato baduk.

La, leolam ema lach chezkato baduk, vehacha bemay askinan — demuchezak lan dela bedak, vekaamri hane: badkinneh. mahu detema: la lehemninhu rabbanan, ka mashma lan: kevan divdikat chametz midderabbanan hu, demiddeorayyta bevittul bealma saggi leh — hemnuhu rabbanan bidrabbanan.
Ibbaya lehu: hammaskir bayit lachavero bechezkat baduk, umetzao sheeno baduk, mahu? mi have kemikkach taut, o la?

Ta shema, deamar abbaye: la mibbaya beatra dela yahavi agra uvedaku — denicha leh leinish lekayyome mitzva begufeh. ella afillu beatra deyahavi agra uvedaku — denicha leh leinish lekayyome mitzva bemamoneh.

Tenan hatam, rabbi meir omer: ochlin kol chamesh, vesorfin bitchillat shesh. rabbi yehuda omer: ochlin kol arba, vetolin kol chamesh, vesorfin bitchillat shesh. dechulle alma miha chametz mishshesh shaot ulemala asur, menalan?
Amar abbaye: tere kerae ketivi, ketiv: "shivat yamim seor lo yimmatze bevattechem", uchetiv: "ach bayyom harishon tashbitu seor mibbattechem". ha ketzad? lerabbot arbaa asar leviur.
Veema lerabbot lele chamishsha asar leviur, desalka datach amena: "yamim" ketiv, yamim — in, lelot — la, ka mashma lan afillu lelot! hahu la itztericha leh,

a: Deha ittakkash hashebatat seor laachilat chametz, vaachilat chametz laachilat matztza.
Hashebatat seor laachilat chametz, dichtiv: "shivat yamim seor lo yimmatze bevattechem ki kol ochel machmetzet venichreta".
Vaachilat chametz laachilat matztza, dichtiv: "kol machmetzet lo tochelu bechol moshvotechem tochlu matztzot (vegomer)", uchetiv beh bematztza: "baerev tochlu matztzot".
Veema lerabbot lel arbaa asar leviur? "bayyom" ketiv.
Veema mitztzafra! "ach" chillek.

Deve rabbi yishmael tana: matzinu arbaa asar shennikra rishon, shenneemar: "barishon bearbaa asar yom lachodesh". rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: rishon — demeikkara mashma, deamar kera: "harishon adam tivvaled".
Ella meatta, "ulekachtem lachem bayyom harishon", hachi name rishon demeikkara mashma?
Shane hatam, dichtiv: "usemachtem lifne Adonai elohechem shivat yamim", ma "shevii" — shevii lechag, af "rishon" — rishon lechag.
Hacha name ketiv: "ach bayyom harishon tashbitu shivat yamim matztzot tochelu"! im ken, nichtov kera "rishon", "harishon" lema li? shema minna lichdaamaran.

I hachi hatam name, "harishon" lema li? vetu, hatam dichtiv: "bayyom harishon shabbaton uvayyom hashshemini shabbaton", emar "rishon" demeikkara mashma? shane hatam deamar kera: "uvayyom hashshemini shabbaton", ma "shemini" — shemini dechag, af "rishon" — rishon dechag.
"Harishon" lema li? lemaote chullo shel moed. chullo shel moed merishon" ushemini" nafka!
Itzterich: salka datach amena, hoil dichtav rachamana: "uvayyom hashshemini", vav mosif al inyan rishon, daafillu bechullo shel moed, ka mashma lan.
Vela lichtov rachamana la vav vela he?! vetu, hatam dichtiv: "bayyom harishon mikra kodesh yihye lachem" — rishon demeikkara mashma?!

Ella, hane shelosha "rishon" mibbee leh lechidtane deve rabbi yishmael. detana deve rabbi yishmael: bischar shelosha "rishon", zachu lishlosha "rishon": lehacherit zaro shel esav, levinyan bet hammikdash, velishmo shel mashiach.

Lehacherit zaro shel esav, dichtiv: "vayyetze harishon admoni kullo keadderet sear". ulevinyan bet hammikdash, dichtiv: "kisse chavod marom merishon mekom mikdashenu". velishmo shel mashiach, dichtiv: "rishon letziyyon hinne hinnam".
Rava amar, mehacha: "lo tishchat al chametz dam zivchi" — lo tishchat happesach vaadayin chametz kayyaym.
Veema: kol chad vechad ki shachet! zeman shechita amar rachamana.

Tanya name hachi: "ach bayyom harishon tashbitu seor mibbattechem" — meerev yom tov. o eno ella beyom tov atzmo? talmud lomar: "lo tishchat al chametz dam zivchi" — lo tishchat et happesach vaadayin chametz kayyaym, divre rabbi yishmael.
Rabbi akiva omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer: "ach bayyom harishon tashbitu seor mibbattechem", uchetiv: "kol melacha lo (taasu)", umatzinu lahaveara shehi av melacha.

Rabbi yose omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer: "ach bayyom harishon tashbitu seor mibbattechem" — meerev yom tov. o eno ella beyom tov — talmud lomar "ach", chillek. vei beyom tov atzmo, mi shere? ha ittakkash hashebatat seor laachilat chametz, vaachilat chametz laachilat matztza! amar rava:
b: Shema minna midderabbi akiva telat. shema minna: en biur chametz ella serefa, ushema minna: haveara lechallek yatzat, ushema minna: la amrinan hoil vehuttera haveara letzorech — huttera name shello letzorech.
Tanu rabbanan: "shivat yamim seor lo yimmatze bevattechem". ma talmud lomar? vahalo kevar neemar: "lo yerae lecha seor [velo yerae lecha chametz] bechol gevulecha"!
Lefi shenneemar: "lo yerae lecha seor" — shellecha i atta roe, aval atta roe shel acherim veshel gavoah. yachol yatmin vikabbel pikdonot min haggoy — talmud lomar "lo yimmatze".
En li ella begoy shello kibbashto, veen sharuy immecha bechatzer. goy shekkibbashto, vesharuy immecha bechatzer minnayin? talmud lomar: "lo yimmatze bevattechem".
En li ella shebbevattechem. bevorot beshichin uvimarot minnayin? talmud lomar "bechol gevulecha".

Vaadayin ani omer: babbattim over mishshum bal yerae uval yimmatze uval yatmin uval yekabbel pikdonot min haggoy. baggevulin — shellecha i atta roe, aval atta roe shel acherim veshel gavoah. minnayin litten et haamur shel ze baze veshel ze baze?

Talmud lomar: "seor" "seor" ligzera shava. neemar seor babbattim: "seor lo yimmatze bevattechem", veneemar seor baggevulin: "lo yerae lecha seor". ma seor haamur babbattim — over mishshum bal yerae uval yimmatze uval yatmin uval yekabbel pikdonot min haggoyim, af seor haamur baggevulin — over mishshum bal yerae uval yimmatze uval yatmin uval yekabbel pikdonot min haggoyim.
Uma seor haamur baggevulin — shellecha i atta roe, aval atta roe shel acherim veshel gavoah, af seor haamur babbattim — shellecha i atta roe, aval atta roe shel acherim veshel gavoah.
Amar mar: en li ella begoy shello kibbashto, veen sharuy immecha bechatzer. goy shekkibbashto, vesharuy immecha bechatzer minnayin? talmud lomar "lo yimmatze".
Kelappe leyay! amar abbaye: efoch.

Rava amar: leolam la tefoch, vearesha kae: shellecha i atta roe, aval atta roe shel acherim veshel gavoah. en li ella begoy shello kibbashto, veen sharuy immecha bechatzer. goy shekkibbashto, vesharuy immecha bechatzer, minnayin? talmud lomar "lo yimmatze".
Vehay tanna meyhaddar ahettera, venasev le kera leissura?! mishshum shenneemar "lecha" "lecha" tere zimne.
Amar mar: yachol yatmin vikabbel pikdonot min haggoyim, talmud lomar: "lo yimmatze". ha amrat resha: shellecha i atta roe, aval atta roe shel acherim veshel gavoah!
La kashya: ha — dekabbel aleh achrayut, ha — dela kabbel aleh achrayut.
Ki ha deamar lehu rava livne machoza: bairu chamira divne chela mibbattayychu. kevan deillu miggenev veillu mittevid birshutayychu kae uvaitu leshallome — kedilchon dame, veasur.
Hanicha leman deamar davar haggorem lemamon — kemamon dame. ella leman deamar lav kemamon dame, may ikka lememar?
Shane hacha, deamar "lo yimmatze".
Ikka deamri: hanicha leman deamar davar haggorem lemamon — lav kemamon dame,

a: Hayeynu deitzterich "lo yimmatze". ella leman deamar kemamon dame — "lo yimmatze" lema li? itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil vechi iteh hadar beeneh — lav birshuteh kae, kamashma lan.
Beo minneh merava: behemat arnona chayyevet bivchora, o en chayyevet bivchora? kol hecha dematze mesallek leh bezuze — la ka mibbaya lan dechayyayv.
Ki ka mibbaya lan — hecha dela matze mesallek leh bezuze, may? amar lehu: petura. vehatanya: chayyevet! hatam dematze mesallek leh.
Ikka deamri, amar rava: behemat arnona petura min habbechora, veaf al gav dematze mesallek leh. issat arnona chayyevet bechalla, veaf al gav dela matze mesallek leh.
May tama: behema it la kala, issa let la kala.
Tanu rabbanan: goy shennichnas lachatzero shel yisrael uvetzeko beyado — en zakuk levaer. hifkido etzlo — zakuk levaer. yiched lo bayit — en zakuk levaer, shenneemar "lo yimmatze".
May kaamar? amar rav pappa: aresha kae, vehachi kaamar: hifkido etzlo — zakuk levaer, shenneemar "lo yimmatze".
Rav ashe amar: leolam assefa kae, vehachi kaamar: yiched lo bayit — en zakuk levaer, shenneemar "lo yimmatze bevattechem", veha lav dideh hu, degoy ki ka meayyel — leveta denafsheh ka meayyel.

Lememra dischirut kanya?! vehatnan: af bemakom sheamru lehasekir — lo levet dira amru, mippene shemmachnisin letocho avodat gillulim. vei salka datach dischirut kanya, ki ka meayyel — leveteh denafsheh ka meayyel?
Shane hacha, deappekeh rachamana bilshon "lo yimmatze" — mi shemmatzuy beyadcha, yatza ze sheeno matzuy beyadcha.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: hammotze chametz beveto beyom tov — kofe alav et hakkeli. amar rava: im shel hekdesh hu — eno tzarich. may tama — mivdal bedili minneh.
Veamar rav yehuda amar rav: chametzo shel goy, ose lo mechitza asara tefachim mishshum hekker. veim shel hekdesh hu — eno tzarich. may tama? mivdal bedili inashe minneh.

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav: hamefaresh, vehayyotze bishyayra, kodem sheloshim yom — en zakuk levaer, toch sheloshim yom — zakuk levaer. amar abbaye: ha deamrat toch sheloshim yom — zakuk levaer, la amaran ella sheddato lachazor, aval en dato lachazor — en zakuk levaer.

Amar leh rava: vei dato lachazor, afillu merosh hashshana name! ella amar rava: ha deamrat kodem sheloshim yom en zakuk levaer, la amaran ella sheen dato lachazor, aval dato lachazor — afillu merosh hashshana zakuk levaer.
Veazda rava letameh. deamar rava: haose beto otzar, kodem sheloshim yom — en zakuk levaer. toch sheloshim yom — zakuk levaer.
Vekodem sheloshim name, la amaran ella sheen dato lefannoto, aval dato lefannoto — afillu kodem sheloshim yom name zakuk levaer.
Hane sheloshim yom, may avidtayyhu? kidtanya: shoalin vedorshin behilchot happesach kodem happesach sheloshim yom. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: shete shabbatot. may tama detanna kamma —
b: Shehare moshe omed befesach rishon, umazhir al happesach sheni, shenneemar: "veyaasu vene yisrael et happasach bemoado", uchetiv: "vayhi anashim asher hayu temeim lenefesh adam".
Verabban shimon ben gamliel amar lach: ayyeyde deayyri bemille defischa, massik lehu lechol mille defischa.

May tama derabban shimon ben gamliel? shehare moshe omed berosh hachodesh, umazhir al happesach, shenneemar: "hachodesh hazze lachem rosh chodashim", uchetiv: "dabberu el kol adat yisrael lemor beasor lachodesh hazze veyikchu lahem ish se levet avot vegomer".
Mimmay divresh yarcha kae? dilma bearbea beyarcha o bechamsha beyarcha kae?

Ella amar rabba bar shimi mishshemeh deravina, mehacha: "vaydabber Adonai el moshe vemidbar sinay bashshana hashshenit bachodesh harishon", uchetiv: "veyaasu vene yisrael et happasach bemoado". hacha name, mimmay divresh yarcha kae? dilma bearbea beyarcha o bechamsha beyarcha kae?

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: atya "midbar" mimmidbar". ketiv hacha: "bemidbar sinay", uchetiv hatam: "vaydabber Adonai el moshe bemidbar sinay beohel moed beechad lachodesh hashsheni". ma lehallan berosh chodesh — af kan berosh chodesh.
Venichtov beresha dechodesh rishon, vahadar nichtov dechodesh sheni. amar rav menashsheya bar tachlifa mishshemeh derav: zot omeret en mukedam umeuchar battora.

Amar rav pappa: la amaran ella bitre inyayne, aval bechad inyayna, may demukedam — mukedam, umay dimuchar — meuchar. dei la tema hachi, "kelal uferat — en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat", dilma perat uchelal hu!
Vetu, "perat uchelal naase kelal musaf al happerat", dilma kelal uferat hu!
I hachi, afillu bitre inyayne name! hanicha leman deamar "kelal uferat hameruchakin ze mizze — en danin oto bichlal uferat", shappir, ella leman deamar "danin", may ikka lememar?
Afillu leman deamar "danin", hane mille — bechad inyayna. aval bitre inyayne — en danin.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: habbodek tzarich sheyyevattel. may tama, i nema mishshum perurin — ha la chashivi.
Vechi tema: kevan dimynattar lehu aggav beteh — chashivi, vehatanya: sofe teenim, umeshammer sadehu mippene anavim. sofe anavim, umeshammer sadehu mippene mikshaot umippene midlaot,
Bizman shebbaal habbayit makpid alehen — asurin mishshum gezel, vechayyayvin bemaaser. bizman sheen baal habbayit makpid alehen — muttarin mishshum gezel, ufeturin mishshum maaser.
Amar rava: gezera shemma yimtza geluseka yafa vedateh illaveh. vechi mashkachat leh levatteleh!

Dilma mashkachat leh levatar issura, velav birshuteh kayyma, vela matze mevattel. deamar rabbi elazar: shene devarim enan birshuto shel adam, vaasaan hakkatuv keillu birshuto, veellu hen: bor birshut harabbim, vechametz mishshesh shaot ulemala.
Venivatteleh bearba, venivatteleh bechamesh? kevan delav zeman issura hu velav zeman biura hu, dilma pasha vela mevattel leh.

a: Venivatteleh beshet! kevan deissura derabbanan illaveh — kidorayyta damya, velav birshuteh kayyma, vela matze mevattel.
Deamar rav giddel amar rabbi chiyyay bar yosef amar rav: hamekaddesh mishshesh shaot ulemala, afillu bechitte kuredinyata — en choshshin lekiddushin.

Ulevatar issura la matze mevattel leh? veha tanya: haya yoshev bevet hammidrash venizkar sheyyesh chametz betoch beto — mevattelo belibbo, echad shabbat veechad yom tov. bishlama shabbat, mashkachat la, kegon shechal arbaa asar lihyot bashshabbat. ella yom tov — batar issura hu!
Amar rav acha bar yaakov: hacha betalmid yoshev lifne rabbo askinan, venizkar sheyyesh issa megulegelet betoch beto, umityayre shemma tachamitz. kadem umevattel lay mikkamme detachmitz.
Dayka name, dekatane: haya yoshev betoch bet hammidrash. shema minna.
Amar rabba bar rav huna amar rav: happat sheippesha. kevan sheravta matztza — mutteret. hechi dame? illema deyada ba dechametz hi — ki ravta matztza may have?
Ella dela yadinan bah i chametz hu i matztza hu — may irya ki ravta matztza? afillu ki lo ravta matztza name, nezil batar batra.
Mi la tenan: maot shennimtzeu lifne sochare vehema — leolam maaser. behar habbayit — chullin.
Birushalayim, bishat haregel — maaser, bishar yemot hashshana — chullin.

Veamar rav shemaya bar zera: may tama — hoil veshuke yerushalayim asuyin lehitkabbed bechol yom. alma amrinan: kammae kammae azli leh, vehane acharine ninhu. hacha name, nema: kamma kamma azel, vehay dehaiddana hu.
Shane hacha deippushah mochiach illavay. i ippushah mochiach illavay, ki ravta matztza may have? amar rabba: la tema sheravta matztza, ella ema: sherabbu yeme matztza illavay.
I hachi, peshita! la tzericha, deippushah merubbe. mahu detema: kevan deippushah merubbe — iggalleya milleta devadday chametz mealleya hu, ka mashma lan:
Kevan sherabbu yeme matztza illavay, amrinan: kol yoma veyoma nahama chammima afa, usheda illavay veafsha tefe.
Umi azlinan batar batra? veha tanya, rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: teva shennishtammeshu bah meot chullin umeot maaser, im rov chullin — chullin, im rov maaser — maaser. veammay? lezil batar batra!

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: hacha bemay askinan — kegon shennishtammeshu bah meot chullin umeot maaser, veen yodea eze mehen bassof. rav zevid amar: kegon shennishtammeshu bah tzibburin tzibburin. rav pappa amar: kegon deishtechach begumma.

Amar rav yehuda: habbodek tzarich sheyyevarech. may mevarech? rav pappe amar mishshemeh derava: (omer) "levaer chametz". rav pappa amar mishshemeh derava: "al biur chametz". bilvaer" — kulle alma la peligi devadday lehabba mashma.
b: Ki peligi beal biur". mar savar: meikkara mashma, umar savar: lehabba mashma.
Metivi: "baruch ... asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al hammila"!
Hatam, hechi nema? nema "lamul" — la saggi delav ihu mahel? avi habben may ikka lememar? in hachi name.
Metivi: "baruch ... asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al hashshechita"! hatam name, hechi nema? nema "lishchot" — la saggi delav ihu shachet?
Pesach vekodashim may ikka lememar? in hachi name.

Metivi: haose lulav leatzmo, mevarech: "shehecheyaynu vekiyyemanu vehiggianu lazzeman hazze". netalo latzet bo, omer: "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al netilat lulav"! shane hatam, dividdana deagbehe nefak beh.
I hachi: "latzet bo"? "yatza bo" mibbee leh! in hachi name, umishshum deka bae lemitna sefa: "leshev bassukka", tena resha name "latzet bo".

Dekatane sefa: haose sukka leatzmo, omer: "baruch atta Adonai ... shehecheyaynu vekiyyemanu vehiggianu lazzeman hazze". nichnas leshev bah, omer: "baruch ... asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu leshev bassukka". vehilcheta: "al biur chametz".
Dechulle alma miha, meikkara bainan levaroche, menalan? deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol hammitzvot mevarech alehen over laasiyyaytan.

May mashma dehay "over" lishshana deakdome hu? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, deamar kera: "vayyarotz achimaatz derech hakkikkar vayyaavor et hakkushi". abbaye amar, mehacha: "vehu avar lifnehem". veibbaet ema mehacha: "vayyaavor malkam lifnehem vaAdonai berosham".
Be rav amri: chutz min hattevila veshofar. bishlama tevila — deakkatti gavra la chaze. ella shofar may tama? vechi tema mishshum dilma mikkalkela tekia. i hachi, afillu shechita umila name!
Ella amar rav chisda: chutz min hattevila bilvad ittemar. tanya name hachi: taval veala, baaliyyayto omer: "baruch ... asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al hattevila".
Leor hanner vechulei. mena hane mille? amar rav chisda: lamadnu metzia mimmetzia, umetzia mechippus, vechippus mechippus, vechippus minnerot, venerot minner.
Metzia mimmetzia — ketiv hacha: "shivat yamim seor lo yimmatze bevattechem", uchetiv hatam: "vaychappes baggadol hechel uvakkaton killa vayyimmatze". umetzia mechippus dideh.
Vechippus minnerot, dichtiv: "baet hahi achappes et yerushalaym bannerot", venerot minner, dichtiv: "ner (elohim) [Adonai] nishmat adam chofes kol chadre vaten".

Tana deve rabbi yishmael: lele arbaa asar bodkim et hechametz leor hanner. af al pi sheen reaya ledavar, zecher laddavar, shenneemar: "shivat yamim seor lo yimmatze", veomer: "vaychappes baggadol hechel uvakkaton killa", veomer: "baet hahi achappes et yerushalaym bannerot", veomer: "ner (elohim) [Adonai] nishmat adam chofes".
May "veomer"?

Vechi tema: hay "baet hahi" — kulla hu dekaamar rachamana: la badekna la birushalayim binhora daavuka — dinfish nehora tuva, ella binhora dishraga — dezutar nehora tefe, deavon rabba mishtechach veavon zutar la mishtechach, ta shema: "ner Adonai nishmat adam".
Tanu rabbanan: en bodkin lo leor hachamma, velo leor hallevana, velo leor haavuka, ella leor hanner,

a: Mippene sheor hanner yafe labbedika. veaf al pi sheen reaya laddavar — zecher laddavar, shenneemar: "shivat yamim seor lo yimmatze bevattechem", veomer: "vaychappes baggadol hechel", veomer: "baet hahi achappes et yerushalaym bannerot", veomer: "ner Adonai nishmat adam chofes kol chadre vaten".
Hay or hachamma hechi dame? i nema bechatzer, haamar rava: chatzer enah tzericha bedika, mippene shehaorvin metzuyin sham. ella beachsadra, haamar rava: achsadra leorah nivdeket!
La tzericha, laarubba divcheder. udehecha? i levahade arubba — hayeynu achsadra. ella litzdadin.

Vaavuka la? vehaamar rava, may dichtiv: "venoga kaor tihye karnayim miyyado lo vesham chevyon uzzo", lema tzaddikim domin bifne shechina — kanner bifne haavuka. veamar rava: avuka lehavedala mitzva min hammuvechar!

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ze — yachol lehacheniso lechorin velisdakin, veze — eno yachol lehacheniso lechorin velisdakin. rav zevid amar: ze — oro lefanav, vaze — oro leacharav. rav pappa amar: hay — beit, vehay — la beit. ravina amar: hay — meshich nehora, vehay — mikkattaf ikkattofe.

Kol makom sheen machnisin kulei. "kol makom" leetoye may? leetoye ha detanu rabbanan: chore bayit haelyonim vehattachtonim, vegag hayyatzia, vegag hammigdal, verefet bakar, velulin, umatben, veotzrot yayin veotzrot shemen — en tzerichin bedika. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: mitta hacholeket betoch habbayit umafseket — tzericha bedika.

Ureminhu: chor shebben adam lachavero — ze bodek ad makom sheyyado maggaat, veze bodek ad makom sheyyado maggaat, vehashshear mevattelo belibbo. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: mitta hacholeket betoch habbayit, veetzim vaavanim sedurim tachteha, umafseket — enah tzericha bedika.
Kashya mitta ammitta, kashya chorin achorin!
Chorin achorin la kashya: ha — beillae uvetattae, veha — bemitze. mitta ammitta la kashya: ha — demiddalleya, ha — demittattay.
Veotzrot yayin en tzarich bedika?! vehatanya: otzrot yayin — tzarich bedika, otzrot shemen — en tzarich bedika! hacha bemay askinan — bemistappek. i hachi, shemen name!
Shemen — yesh keva laachila. yayin — en keva lishtiyya.
Tane rabbi chiyyay: asu otzrot shechar bevavel keotzrot yayin beeretz yisrael, bemistappek.
Amar rav chisda: be dagim en tzarich bedika. vehatanya tzerichin bedika! la kashya: ha — beravreve, ha — bezutere.
Amar rabba bar rav huna: be milche uve kire tzarich bedika. amar rav pappa: be tzive uve tamre tzarich bedika.
Tana: en mechayyeyvin oto lehachenis yado lechorin velisdakin livdok — mippene hassakkana. may sakkana? i nema mippene sakkanat akrav — ki mishtammash, hechi ishtammash? la tzericha, dinfal.
I nefal, lema li bedika? vehatnan: chametz shennafla alav mappolet — hare hu kimvoar! hatam sheen hakkelev yachol lechappes acharav, hacha keshehakkelev yachol lechappes acharav.
Veha amar rabbi elazar: sheluche mitzva enan nizzokin? amar rav ashe: shemma tovad lo machat, veate leayyone batra.
Uchehay gavvna lav mitzva hu?! vehatanya: haomer "sela zo litzdaka bishvil sheyyichye beni" o "sheehye ben haolam habba" —
b: Hare ze tzaddik gamur! dilma batar devadek ate leayyone batra.

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: mishshum sakkanat haggoyim, ufelemo hi. detanya: chor shebben yehudi learmay — bodek ad mekom sheyyado maggaat, vehashshear mevattelo belibbo. pelemo amar: kol atzmo eno bodek mippene hassakkana.
May sakkana, i nema sakkanat keshafim, ki ishtammaysh hechi ishtammaysh? hatam ki ishtammaysh — yemama unehora, vela massik addateh. hacha — lelya usheraga hu, umassek addateh.

Vehaamar rabbi elazar: sheluche mitzva enan nizzokin! hecha dishchiach hezzeka shane. shenneemar: "vayyomer shemuel ech elech veshama shaul vaharagani vayyomer Adonai eglat bakar tikkach beyadecha vegomer".
Beo minneh merav: hane bene be rav dedayyri bevaga, mahu lemete kadma vachashocha leve rav? amar lehu: neto alay veal tzavvari. nezil may? amar lehu: la yadana.
Ittemar, amar rabbi elazar: sheluche mitzva enan nizzokin lo bahalichatan velo bachaziratan. keman?

Ki hay tanna detanya, isi ben yehuda omer: kelappe sheamra tora "velo yachmod ish et artzecha", melammed shettehe paratcha roa baafar veen chayya mazzikatah, tarnegoltecha menakkeret baashpa veen chuleda mazzikatah.

Vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma ellu sheddarkan lizzok — enan nizzokin, bene adam sheen darkan lizzok — al achat kamma vechamma. en li ella bahalicha, bachazara minnayin? talmud lomar: "ufanita vabboker vehalachta leohalecha", melammed shettelech vetimtza ahalcha beshalom.
Vechi meachar daafillu bachazira, bahalicha lema li? lechidrabbi amme. deamar rabbi amme: kol adam sheyyesh lo karka — ole laregel, vesheen lo karka — en ole laregel.

Amar rabbi avin bar rav adda amar rabbi yitzchak: mippene ma en perot ginnosar birushalayim? kede shello yehu ole regalim omrim: ilmale lo alinu ella leechol perot ginnosar birushalayim — dayyenu. nimtzet aliyyay shello lishmah.

Kayyotze bo, amar rabbi dostay berabbi yannay: mippene ma en chamme teverya birushalayim? kede shello yehu ole regalim omrim: ilmale lo alinu ella lirchotz bechamme teverya — dayyenu, venimtzet aliyyay shello lishmah.
Uvamma amru shete shurot vechulei. martef man dechar shemeh?

Hachi kaamar: kol makom sheen machnisin bo chametz — en tzarich bedika, veotzrot yayin veotzrot shemen name en tzarich bedika, uvamma amru shete shurot bammartef — makom shemmachnisin bo chametz, uvemistappek.
Bet shammay omrim shete shurot vechulei. amar rav yehuda: shete shurot sheamru, min haaretz vead sheme kora. verabbi yochanan amar: shura achat kemin gam.

Tanya kevateh derav yehuda, tanya kevoteh derabbi yochanan. tanya kevoteh derav yehuda, bet shammay omrim: shete shurot al pene kol hammartef, ushete shurot sheamru — min haaretz vead sheme kora. tanya kevoteh derabbi yochanan: shete shurot al pene kol hammartef — chitzona roa et happetach, veelyona roa et hakkora. shellifnim hemenna, veshellematta hemenna — en tzarich bedika.

Bet hillel omrim shete shurot hachitzonot shehen haelyonot. amar rav: elyona veshellematta hemenna, ushemuel amar: elyona veshellifnim hemenna. may tama derav — dayek "chitzonot". veha elyonot katane! lemaote tattae detattayayta.

Ushemuel amar: elyona veshellifnim hemenna. may tama — dayek "elyonot". veha chitzona katane! lemaote gavayayta degavayayta. rabbi chiyyay tane kevoteh derav, vechullehu tannae tanu kevoteh dishmuel, vehilcheta kevoteh dishmuel.

a: Mishna en choshshin shemma gerra chuleda mibbayit levayit umimmakom lemakom, deim ken mechatzer lechatzer umeir lair — en laddavar sof.
Gemara tama dela chazena dishkal, ha chazena dishkal — chayyshinan, uvae bedika.
Veammay? nema achalteh! mi la tenan: medorot haggoyim temeim. vechamma yishhe bemador vihe hammador tzarich bedika — arbaim yom.
Veaf al pi sheen lo ishsha. vechol makom shechuleda vachazir yecholin lahaloch — en tzarich bedika!
Amar rabbi zera, la kashya: ha bevasar, veha belechem. bevasar — la meshayyeyra. belechem — meshayyeyra.

Amar rava: hay may? bishlama hatam — emor hava, emor la hava. veim timtza lomar hava — emor achalteh. aval hacha, devadday dachazena dishkal — mi yemar daachalteh? have safek uvadday, veen safek motzi mide vadday.

Veen safek motzi mide vadday?! veha tanya: chaver shemmet vehinniach megura melea perot, vaafillu hen bene yoman — hare hen bechezkat metukkanin. veha hacha, devadday tevili hane pere, vesafek meussarin vesafek lo meussarin, vekaate safek umotzi mide vadday!
Hatam vadday uvadday hu, devadday measseri, kidrabbi chanina chozaa. deamar rabbi chanina chozaa: chazaka al chaver sheen motzi mittachat yado davar sheeno metukkan.
Vei baet ema: safek vesafek hu, dilma meikkara emor dela tevili, kerabbi oshaya.
Deamar rabbi oshaya: maarim adam al tevuato, umachnisah bammotz shellah, kede shettehe behemto ochelet ufetura min hammaaser.
Veen safek motzi mide vadday?! vehatanya amar rabbi yehuda: maase beshifchato shel metzik echad berimmon shehetila nefel levor,
b: Uva kohen vehetzitz bo leda im zachar hu im nekeva hi. uva maase lifne chachamim, vetiharuhu, mippene shechuleda uvardelas metzuyin sham.

Veha hacha — devadday hetila, vesafek gerruhu vesafek lo gerruhu hahi shata, vekaate safek umotzi mide vadday! la tema "shehetila nefel levor", ella ema: "shehippila kemin nefel levor", vehave safek vesafek.
Veha "leda im zachar hu im nekeva hi" katane! hachi kaamar: leda im ruach hippila, im nefel hippila. veim timtza lomar nefel hippila: leda im zachar hu veim nekeva hi.

Veibbaet ema: hatam vadday uvadday hu, kevan dechuleda uvardelas metzuyin sham — vadday gerruhu behahi shata. nehi deshayyore meshayyeyra — migrar mihat vadday gerrum behahi shata. (lishshana acharina: nehi devadday achalum la amrinan, vadday gerruhu lechorayyhu — amrinan.)
Umi amrinan en choshshin shemma gerra chuleda? veha katane sefa: ma shemmeshayyer yannichennu betzina, shello yehe tzarich bedika acharav.
Amar abbaye: la kashya ha — bearbaa asar, ha — bishlosha asar. bishlosha asar dishchiach rifta bechullehu batte — la matznea. bearbaa asar dela shechicha rifta bechullehu batte — matznea.

Amar rava: vechi chuleda nevia hi! deyada dehaiddana arbesar, vela afe ad leureta, umeshayyeyra umetammera?! ella, amar rava: ma shemmeshayyer — yannichennu betzina, shemma tittol chuleda befanenu, vihe tzarich bedika acharav.
Tanya kevoteh derava: harotze leechol chametz achar bedika, ketzad yaase? ma shemmeshayyer yannichennu betzina, shello tavo chuleda vetittol befanenu, vihe tzarich bedika acharav.
Rav mari amar: gezera shemma yanniach eser veyimtza tesha.
Tesha tzibburin shel matztza veechad shel chametz, vaata achbar ushekal. vela yadinan i matztza shekal i chametz shekal — hayeynu tesha chanuyot. peresh, vaata achbar ushekal — hayeynu sefa.
Ditnan: tesha chanuyot, kullan mochrin besar shechuta, veachat mocheret besar nevela, velakach meachat mehen, veeno yodea meeze mehen lakach — sefeko asur.
Uvannimtza — hallech achar harov.

Shene tzibburin, echad shel matztza veechad shel chametz. velifnehem shene vattim, echad baduk veechad sheeno baduk. vaato shene achbarim, echad shekal matztza, veechad shekal chametz. vela yadinan he lehay ayel vehe lehay ayel, hayeynu shete kuppot.

Ditnan: shete kuppot, achat shel chullin veachat shel teruma. velifnehem shene sein, echad shel chullin veechad shel teruma. venaflu ellu letoch ellu — muttarin. sheani omer, chullin letoch chullin naflu, uteruma letoch teruma nafla.
Emor deamrinan "sheani omer"

a: Bitruma derabbanan. bechametz deorayyta mi amrinan?! attu bedikat chametz deorayyta? derabbanan hi! demiddeorayyta bevittul bealma saggi leh.

Tzibbur echad shel chametz ulefanav shene vattim bedukin, vaata achbar ushekal, vela yadinan i lehay al i lehay al — hayeynu shene shevilin. ditnan: shene shevilin, echad tame veechad tahor, vehalach beechad mehen veasa teharot, uva chavero vehalach bashsheni veasa teharot.
Rabbi yehuda omer: im nishalu ze bifne atzmo veze bifne atzmo — tehorin. shenehen bevat achat — temein. rabbi yosi omer: ben kach uven kach temein.

Amar rava veittema rabbi yochanan: bevat achat — divre hakkol temein. beze achar ze — divre hakkol tehorin. lo nechleku ella beva lehishshael alav veal chavero. rabbi yose medamme leh levat achat, verabbi yehuda medamme leh leze achar ze.
Safek al, safek la al — hayeynu bika, uviflugeta derabbi eliezer verabbanan.

Ditnan: hannichnas levika bimot haggeshamim, vetumea besade pelonit, veamar echad: halachti bammakom hallaz, veeni yodea im nichnasti beotah sade veim lo nichnasti. rabbi eliezer metaher, vachachamim metammein.
Shehaya rabbi eliezer omer: sefek bia — tahor, sefek magga tumea — tame.
Al, uvedak vela ashkach — pelugeta derabbi meir verabbanan, ditnan: haya rabbi meir omer: kol davar shebbechezkat tumea, leolam hu betumeato ad sheyyivvada lach hattumea hechan hi.
Vachachamim omrim: bodek ad shemmaggia lesela o lekarka betula.
Al, uvedak veashkach — pelugeta derabbi verabban shimon ben gamliel.

Detanya: sade shenneevad bah kever — hannichnas letochah tame. nimtza bah kever — hannichnas letochah tahor, sheani omer: kever sheavad hu kever shennimtza — divre rabbi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: tibbadek kol hassade kullah.
Hinniach tesha umatza eser — pelugeta derabbi verabbanan. detanya: hinniach mane umatza matayim, chullin umaaser sheni meoravin ze baze — divre rabbi.
Vachachamim omrim: hakkol chullin.
Hinniach eser umatza tesha hayeynu sefa, detanya: hinniach matayim umatza mane — mane munnach umane mutal, divre rabbi.
Vachachamim omrim: hakkol chullin.
b: Hinniach bezavit zo umatza bezavit acheret — pelugeta derabban shimon ben gamliel verabbanan, detanya: kardom sheavad bevayit — habbayit tame. sheani omer: adam tame nichnas lesham unetalo. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: habbayit tahor, sheani omer: hishilo leacher veshachach, o shennetalo mizzavit zo vehinniach bezavit haacheret veshachach.
Zavit man dechar shemeh?

Chassore mechassera, vehachi katane: kardom sheavad bevayit — habbayit tame, sheani omer: adam tame nichnas lesham unetalo. o shehinnicho bezavit zo umetzao bezavit acheret — habbayit tame, sheani omer: adam tame nichnas lesham unetalo mizzavit zo vehinnicho bezavit acheret. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: habbayit tahor, sheani omer hishilo leacher veshachach, o shennetalo mizzavit zo vehinniach bezavit zo veshachach.

Amar rava: achbar nichnas vechikkar befiv, venichnas acharav umatza perurin — tzarich bedika, mippene sheen darko shel achbar lefarer. veamar rava: tinok nichnas vechikkar beyado, venichnas acharav umatza perurin — en tzarich bedika, mippene sheddarko shel tinok lefarer.
Bae rava: achbar nichnas vechikkar befiv, veachbar yotze vechikkar befiv, mahu? mi amrinan: hayeynu hay deal, vehayeynu hay dinfak. o dilma, acharina hu.
Im timtza lomar hayeynu hay deal vehayeynu hay dinfak: achbar lavan nichnas vechikkar befiv, veachbar shachor yotze vechikkar befiv, mahu? hay vadday acharina hu. o dilma, armoye armeye minneh?

Veim timtza lomar achbarim la shakli mehadade: achbar nichnas vechikkar befiv, vechuleda yotza vechikkar befiha, mahu? chuleda vadday meachbar shekalteh. o dilma, acharina hu. deim ita demeachbar shekalteh — achbar befiha hava mishtechach.

Veim timtza lomar im ita demeachbar shekalteh, achbar befiha hava mishtechach: achbar nichnas vechikkar befiv, vechuleda yotza vechikkar veachbar befi chuleda, mahu? hacha vadday ihu hu, o dilma: im ita deihu nihu — kikkar befi achbar mishtechach hava bae ishtechoche. o dilma: mishshum biatuta hu nefal, ushekalteh. teku.

Bae rava: kikkar bishme kora — tzarich sullam lehoridah, o en tzarich? mi amrinan: kulle hay la atrechuhu rabbanan, kevan dela nachet minnafsheh — la ate lemechla. o dilma: zimnin denafel veate lemechla.

Veim timtze lomar zimnin denafel veate lemechla: kikkar bevor — tzarich sullam lehaalotah, o en tzarich? hacha vadday dela avida desalka minnafsha, o dilma: zimnin denachet lemebad tzurekeh, veate lemechlay.
Im timtza lomar zimnin denachet letzurekeh veate lemechla: kikkar befi nachash — tzarich chabbar lehotzi, o en tzarich?
Begufeh atrechuhu rabbanan, bemamoneh la atrechuhu rabbanan. o dilma la shena. teku.
Mishna rabbi yehuda omer: bodkin or arbaa asar, uvearbaa asar shacharit, uvishat habbiur. vachachamim omrim: lo badak or arbaa asar — yivdok bearbaa asar.
Lo badak bearbaa asar — yivdok betoch hammoed. lo badak betoch hammoed — yivdok leachar hammoed. uma shemmeshayyer yannichennu betzina, kede shello yehe tzarich bedika acharav.

Gemara may tama derabbi yehuda? rav chisda verabba bar rav huna deamri tarvayyhu: keneged shalosh hashebatot shebbattora — "lo yerae lecha chametz velo yerae lecha seor", "shivat yamim seor lo yimmatze bevattechem", "ach bayyom harishon tashbitu seor mibbattechem".
Metiv rav yosef, rabbi yehuda omer: kol shello badak bishlosha perakim hallalu — shuv eno bodek. alma bemikkan veelach hu difligi.
Mar zutera matne hachi: metiv rav yosef, rabbi yehuda omer: kol shello badak beechad mishshelosha perakim hallalu — shuv eno bodek. alma beshuv eno bodek hu difligi.
Ella rabbi yehuda name, im lo badak kaamar.
Vehacha beha kamippalgi: mar savar: mikkamme issura — in, batar issura — la, gezera dilma ate lemechal minneh. verabbanan savri: la gazrinan.
Umi gazar rabbi yehuda dilma ate lemechal minneh? veha tenan: mishshekkarav haomer yotzin umotzin shuke yerushalayim shehem meleim kemach vekali.

a: Shello birtzon chachamim (hen osin), divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: birtzon chachamim hayu osin. vela ka gazar rabbi yehuda dilma ate lemechal minneh? amar rava: shane chadash, mittoch shello hittarta lo ella al yede kittuf, hu zachur.
Amar leh abbaye: tinach bishat ketifa, techina veharekada may ikka lememar? ha la kashya: techina berichya deyad, harekada al gabbe nafa.
Ella ha ditnan: kotzrin bet hashshelachim veshebbaamakim, aval lo godshin. veokimna kerabbi yehuda, may ikka lememar!
Ella amar abbaye: chadash — badel minneh, chametz — la badel minneh.
Amar rava: derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda kashya, derabbanan adderabbanan la kashya?
Derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya — kidshanninan. derabbanan adderabbanan name la kashya — hu atzmo mechazzer alav lesorfo, mechal kaachel minneh?!
Rav ashe amar: derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya: "kemach vekali" tenan.
Ha derav ashe beduta hi: hatinach mikkali veelach, meikkara ad kali may ikka lememar?
Vechi tema al yede kittuf kidrava, ella "kotzrin bet hashshelachin veshebbaamakim", veokimna kerabbi yehuda, may ikka lememar? ella derav ashe beduta hi.
Vechol hecha dela badel minneh, mi gazar rabbi yehuda?
Vehatnan: lo yikkov adam shefoferet shel betza vimalleenna shemen veyittenenna betzad hanner bishvil shettehe menattefet, vaafillu hi shel cheres.
Verabbi yehuda mattir! hatam, mishshum chumera deshabbat mivdal bedili.
Uremi deshabbat ashshabbat, detanya: chevel deli shennifsak, lo yehe koshro ella onvo. rabbi yehuda omer: korech alav puneda o pasikya, uvilvad shello yaanvennu.
Kashya derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda, kashya derabbanan adderabbanan!
Derabbanan adderabbanan la kashya: shemen beshemen — michallaf, aniva bikshira — la michallaf.
Derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya: tama derabbi yehuda lav mishshum degazar aniva attu keshira, ella mishshum dekasavar aniva gufa keshira hi.

Verame rabbanan adderabbanan, ditnan: koshrin deli befasikya aval lo bechevel, verabbi yehuda mattir. chevel demay? illema chevel dealma, "verabbi yehuda mattir"? kesher shel kayyayma hu, devadday ate levattole!
Ella peshita degardi.
Ugezaru rabbanan chevel degardi attu chevel dealma? in, chevel bechevel — michallaf, aniva bikshira — la michallefa.
Vechol hecha devadel minneh la gazar rabbi yehuda? vehatanya: bechor sheachazo dam, afillu hu met — en makkizin lo dam, divre rabbi yehuda.
Vachachamim omrim: yakkiz, uvilvad shello yatil bo mum. hatam, mittoch sheadam bahul
b: Al mamono, amrinan: i sharet leh bimkom sheen osin bo mum — ate lemebad bimkom sheosin bo mum.
Verabbanan — kol shekken dei la sharet leh kelal ate lemebad.

Umi amrinan lerabbi yehuda adam bahul al mamono? vehatnan, rabbi yehuda omer: en (mekadderin) habbehema beyom tov — mippene shehu ose chabbura, aval mekartzefin. vachachamim omrim: en mekadderin, af en mekartzefin.
Vetanya: ezehu kiddur veezehu kirtzuf? kiddur — ketannim, veosin chabbura. kirtzuf — gedolim, veen osin chabbura.
Hatam, dei shavek leh — mayet, amrinan adam bahul al mamono. hacha, i shavek leh — tzaara bealma hu, la amrinan adam bahul al mamono.
Verabbi yehuda, may shena gabbe chametz degazar, umay shena gabbe kirtzuf dela gazar? lechem belechem — michallaf. kiddur bekirtzuf — la michallaf.
Mishna rabbi meir omer: ochlim kol chamesh, vesorfin bitchillat shesh. rabbi yehuda omer: ochlin kol arba, vetolin kol chamesh, vesorfin bitchillat shesh.

Veod amar rabbi yehuda: shete challot shel toda pesulot munnachot al gav haitzteva, kol zeman shemmunnachot — kol haam ochlin. nittela achat — tolin; lo ochlin velo sorfin. nittelu shetehen — hitchilu kol haam sorfin.
Rabban gamliel omer: chullin neechalin kol arba, uteruma kol chamesh, vesorfin bitchillat shesh.
Gemara tenan hatam: echad omer bishnayim bachodesh, veechad omer bishlosha — edutan kayyemet,
Shezze yodea beibburo shel chodesh, veze eno yodea beibburo shel chodesh.

Echad omer bishlosha, veechad omer bachamishsha — edutan betela. echad omer bishte shaot, veechad omer beshalosh shaot — edutan kayyemet. echad omer beshalosh, veechad omer bechamesh — edutan betela, divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi yehuda omer: edutan kayyemet. echad omer bechamesh, veechad omer besheva — edutan betela. shebbechamesh chamma bemizrach, uvesheva chamma bemaarav.

Amar abbaye: keshettimtza lomar, ledivre rabbi meir — en adam toe velo kelum; ledivre rabbi yehuda — adam toe chatzi shaa. ledivre rabbi meir — en adam toe velo kelum: maase ki hava, bemippak tarte umeayyel telat. veha dekaamar shetayim — besof shetayim, veha dekaamar shalosh — bitchillat shalosh.

Ledivre rabbi yehuda — adam toe chatzi shaa: maase ki hava, befalga dearba hava, vehay dekaamar shalosh — besof shalosh, vekatae palga deshata lekammeh. vehay dekaamar chamesh — bitchillat chamesh, vekatae palga deshata laachoreh.

Ikka deamri, amar abbaye: keshettimtza lomar, ledivre rabbi meir — adam toe mashshehu; ledivre rabbi yehuda — adam toe shaa umashshehu. ledivre rabbi meir — adam toe mashshehu: maase ki hava, o besof shetayim hava o bitchillat shalosh, vechad minnayyhu toe mashshehu. ledivre rabbi yehuda — adam toe shaa umashshehu: maase ki hava — o besof shalosh o bitchillat chamesh,

a: Vechad minnayyhu katae shaa umashshehu.

Azal rav huna bereh derav yehuda, amra lishmateta kammeh derava. amar: uma illu dayykinan behane sahade, dehay dekaamar shalosh — bitchillat shalosh, vehay dekaamar chamesh — besof chamesh, vehavya edut muchecheshet, vela katlinan, vaanan nekum venikketoyl missefeka?! verachamana amar: "veshaftu haeda" "vehitztzilu haeda"!

Ella amar rava: ledivre rabbi meir — adam toe shete shaot chaser mashshehu; ledivre rabbi yehuda — adam toe shalosh shaot chaser mashshehu. ledivre rabbi meir — adam toe shete shaot chaser mashshehu, maase ki hava, o bitchillat shetayim o besof shalosh, vechad minnayyhu katae shete shaot chaser mashshehu.
Ledivre rabbi yehuda — adam toe shalosh shaot chaser mashshehu, maase ki hava o bitchillat shalosh o besof chamesh, vechad minnayyhu katae shalosh shaot chaser mashshehu.

Tenan: hayu bodkin oto besheva chakirot: beezo shavua, beezo shana, beeze chodesh, bechamma bachodesh, beeze yom, beezo shaa, beeze makom. (vetanya:) ma ben chakirot livdikot? chakirot, amar echad mehen "eni yodea" — edutan betela. bedikot, afillu shenehem omrim "en anu yodim" — edutan kayyemet.
Vehavinan ba: may shena chakirot umay shena bedikot?
Veamrinan: chakirot, amar echad mehen "eni yodea" — edutan betela, dehavya la edut shei atta yachol lahazimmah.
Bedikot, edut sheatta yachol lahazimmah hi.
Vei amrat tae inish kulle hay, chakirot deezo shaa" name edut shei atta yachol lahazimmah hi, deamri: mite katainan!
Deyahavinan lehu kulle tautayyhu. lerabbi meir — yahavinan lehu mittechillat shaa rishona ad sof chamesh.
Uvedin hu denittev lehu meikkara tefe, ella ben yemama lelelya la tau inashe.
Ulerabbi yehuda — yahavinan lehu mittechillat shaa rishona vead sof shishshit. uvedin hu denittev lehu meikkara tefe,
b: Ella ben yemama lelelya la tau inashe. uvedin hu denittev lekammeh tefe, ella shebbechamesh chamma bammizrach, uvesheva chamma bammaarav.
Tenan rabbi meir omer: ochlin kol chamesh, vesorfin bitchillat shesh. rabbi yehuda omer: ochlin kol arba, vetolin kol chamesh, vesorfin bitchillat shesh.
Leabbaye allibba derabbi meir, deamar: en adam toe velo kelum — nechol kulla shet. ulehach lishshana name deamar: adam toe mashshehu — nechol ad sof shet.
Veabbaye allibba derabbi yehuda, deamar: adam toe chatzi shaa — nechol ad palga deshet. ulehach lishshana name deamrat: adam toe shaa umashshehu — nechol ad sof chamesh.
(Ella) amar abbaye: edut mesura lizrizim, chametz lakkol masur.
Verava allibba derabbi meir, deamar: adam toe shete shaot chaser mashshehu — mittechillat chamesh la nechol! chamesh chamma bammizrach, vesheva chamma bammaarav.
I hachi, beshet name nechol?! amar rav adda bar ahava: shet, yoma bekarnata kae.

Verava allibba derabbi yehuda, deamar: adam toe shalosh shaot chaser mashshehu — mittechillat arba la nechol! chamesh chamma bammizrach, vesheva chamma bammaarav. vechol shekken arba. i hachi, bechamesh name nechol!
Targema abbaye allibba derava: edut mesura lizrizim, chametz lakkol masur.
Verava amar: lav hayeynu tama derabbi yehuda. ella rabbi yehuda letameh, deamar: en biur chametz ella serefa, vihavu leh rabbanan shaa achat lilkot bah etzim.
Etiveh ravina lerava: amar rabbi yehuda: ematay — shello bishat biuro. aval bishat biuro — hashebatato bechol davar!
Ella amar rava: gezera mishshum yom hameunnan. i hachi, afillu bearba shaot name la nechol! amar rav pappa: arba zeman seuda lakkol hi.
Tanu rabbanan: shaa rishona — maachal ludim. sheniyya — maachal listin. shelishit — maachal yorshin. reviit — maachal poalin. chamishit — maachal talmide chachamim. shishshit — maachal kol adam.
Vehaamar rav pappa: reviit — zeman seuda lechol hi! ella efoch: reviit — maachal kol adam, chamishit — maachal poalim, shishshit — maachal talmide chachamim.
Mikkan veelach, kezorek even lachemet. amar abbaye: la amaran ella dela taem midde betzafra. aval taem midde betzafra — let lan ba.
Amar rav ashe: kemachloket beedut, kach machloket bechametz. peshita, hayeynu hach deamrinan! ha ka mashma lan: shinnuye deshanninan — shinnuya hu, vela tema tannae hi.
Amar rav shimi bar ashe: lo shanu ella beshaot, aval echad omer kodem hanetz hachamma veechad omer achar hanetz hachamma — edutan betela. peshita!
Ella: echad omer kodem hanetz hachamma veechad omer betoch hanetz hachamma — edutan betela. ha name peshita! mahu detema: tarvayyhu chada milleta kaamri, veha dekaamar

a: Betoch hanetz hachamma — begilluyay hava kae, vezaharure bealma hu dachaza. ka mashma lan.
Amar rav nachman amar rav: halacha kerabbi yehuda. amar leh rava lerav nachman: venema mar halacha kerabbi meir, distam lan tena kevoteh.
Ditnan: kol shaa shemmuttar leechol — maachil!
Hahi lav setama hu, mishshum dekashya "muttar".
Venema mar halacha kerabban gamliel, dehave leh machria. amar leh: rabban gamliel lav machria hu, taam denafsheh kaamar.

Veibbaet ema: rav deamar ki hay tanna, detanya: arbaa asar shechal lihyot beshabbat — mevaarin et hakkol millifne hashshabbat. vesorfin terumot temeot, teluyot, utehorot. umeshayyeyrin min hattehorot mezon shete seudot, kede leechol ad arba shaot, divre rabbi elazar ben yehuda ish bartota, sheamar mishshum rabbi yehoshua.
Amru lo: tehorot lo yissarfu, shemma yimmatzu lahen ochlin. amar lahen: kevar bikkeshu velo matzu. amru lo: shemma chutz lachoma lanu?

Amar lahem: ledivrechem, af teluyot lo yissarfu — shemma yavo eliyyahu vitaharem. amru lo: kevar muvetach lahen leyisrael sheen eliyyahu ba lo bearve shabbatot velo bearve yamim tovim, mippene hattorach.
Amru: lo zazu mishsham ad shekkavu halacha kerabbi elazar ben yehuda ish bartota sheamar mishshum rabbi yehoshua.
May lav, afillu leechol? amar rav pappa mishshemeh derava: lo, levaer.

Veaf rabbi savar leha derav nachman. deamar ravin bar rav adda: maase beadam echad shehifkid disakkayya melea chametz etzel yochanan chakokaa, unekavuha achbarim, vehaya chametz mevatzbetz veyotze. uva lifne rabbi, shaa rishona amar lo: hameten. sheniyya, amar lo: hameten. shelishit, amar lo: hameten. reviit, amar lo: hameten. chamishit, amar lo: tze umochreha bashshuk.
May lav, legoyim — kerabbi yehuda? amar rav yosef: la, leyisrael — kerabbi meir. amar leh abbaye: i leyisrael — nishkeleh lenafsheh?
Mishshum chashada, detanya: gabbae tzedaka sheen lahem aniyyim lechallek — portin laacherim, veen portin leatzman.
Gabbae tamchuy, sheen lahem aniyyim lechallek — mochrin laacherim veen mochrin leatzman, mishshum shenneemar: "vihyitem nekiyyim meAdonai umiyyisrael".
Amar leh rav adda bar matna lerav yosef: beferush amart lan, tze umochren laggoyim, kerabbi yehuda.

Amar rav yosef: keman azla ha shemata derabbi — kerabban shimon ben gamliel, ditnan: hammafkid perot etzel chavero, afillu hen avudin — lo yigga bahen. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: mochran bevet din mippene hashavat aveda.
Amar leh abbaye: velav ittemar ala, amar rabba bar bar chana amar rav yochanan: lo shanu ella
b: Bichde chesronan, aval yoter mikkede chesronan — mochran bevet din. vechol shekken hacha, deha pesidi ligmare.
Veod amar rabbi yehuda shete challot kulei. tane tanna kammeh derav yehuda "al gav haitzteva". amar leh: vechi lehatzenian hu tzarich?! teni "al gag haitzteva".
Amar rachava amar rabbi yehuda: har habbayit setav kaful haya. tanya name hachi: har habbayit setav kaful haya. rabbi yehuda omer: istevonit hayta nikret — setav lefanim missetav.
Pesulot vechulei. ammay pesulot? amar rabbi chanina: mittoch shehayu merubbot — nifsalot belina. detanya: en meviin toda bechag hammatztzot, mippene chametz shebbah.
Peshita? amar rav adda bar ahava: hacha bearbaa asar askinan, vekasavar: en meviin kadashim levet happesul.
Vechulle alma bishlosha asar mayyte lehu, umittoch shehen merubbot — nifsalot belina.
Mishshum rabbi yannay amru: kesherot hayu, veella ammay kare lehu pesulot — shello nishchat alehen hazzevach. venishchot! sheavad hazzevach.

Venayyte zevach acher venishchot! deamar: "zo toda vezo lachmah", vechidrabba. deamar rabba: avad hallechem — mevi lechem acher, avda toda — en mevi toda acheret. may tama — lechem gelal toda, veen toda gelal lechem.
Venifrekinhu venappekinhu lechullin! ella: leolam shennishchat alehen hazzevach venishpach haddam.

Ucheman — kerabbi. deamar rabbi: shene devarim hammattirin — maalin ze belo ze. detanya: kivse atzeret en mekaddeshin et hallechem ella bishchita. ketzad? shechatan lishman vezarak daman lishman — kiddesh hallechem.
Shechatan shello lishman vezarak daman shello lishman — lo kiddesh hallechem. shechatan lishman vezarak daman shello lishman — lechem kadosh veeno kadosh, divre rabbi.
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: leolam eno kadosh hallechem, ad sheyyishchot lishman veyizrok daman lishman.
Afillu tema rabbi elazar berabbi shimon, hacha bemay askinan, kegon shennitkabbel haddam bechos venishpach,
Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon savar leh kaavu, deamar: kol haomed lizrok kezaruk dame.
Tana, mishshum rabbi elazar amru: kesherot hayu. kol zeman shemmunnachot — kol haam ochlin. nittela achat mehen — tolin; lo ochlin velo sorfin. nittelu shetehen — hitchilu kullan sorfin.
Tanya, abba shaul omer:

a: Shete farot hayu chorshot behar hammishcha. kol zeman sheshshetehen chorshot — kol haam ochlin. nittelet achat mehen — tolin; lo ochlin velo sorfin. nittelu shetehen — hitchilu kol haam sorfin.
Mishna rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer: mimehem shel kohanim lo nimneu millisrof et habbasar shennitma bivvlad hattumea im habbasar shennitma beav hattumea, af al pi shemmosifin tumea al tumeato.
Hosif rabbi akiva veamar: mimehem shel kohanim lo nimneu millehadlik et hashshemen shennifsal bitvul yom bener shennitma bitme met, af al pi shemmosifin tumea al tumeato.
Amar rabbi meir: middivrehem lamadnu shessorfin teruma tehora im hattemea bappesach. amar rabbi yose: enah hi hammidda.

Umodim rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua shessorfin zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah. al ma nechleku — al hatteluya veal hattemea. sherabbi eliezer omer: tissaref zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah, verabbi yehoshua omer: shetehen keachat.
Gemara mikkede basar shennitma bivvlad hattumea may have — sheni, ki saref leh bahade basar shennitma beav hattumea may have — sheni,
Sheni vesheni hu. may mosif lo tumea al tumeato ikka?
Amar rav yehuda: hacha bivvlad vevlad askinan, dehave leh shelishi, vekasavar shelishi muttar laasoto sheni.
Veha en ochel metamme ochel! detanya: yachol yehe ochel metamme ochel, talmud lomar: "vechi yuttan mayim al zera venafal minnivlatam alav tame hu" — hu tame, veen ose kayyotze bo tame.
Hanicha leabbaye deamar: lo shanu ella bechullin, aval bitruma vekodashim — ose kayyotze bo.
Ulerav adda bar ahava mishshemeh derava name deamar: lo shanu ella chullin uteruma, aval bekadashim — ose kayyotze bahen, shappir.
Ella leravina mishshemeh derava deamar: mikra male dibber hakkatuv, la shena chullin, la shena teruma, la shena kadashim — eno ose kayyotze bo. may ikka lememar?
Hacha vemay askinan? deikka mashkin bahade basar, deka mittamme mechamat mashkin.
I hachi, hay "im habbasar shennitma beav hattumea" — "im habbasar umashkin" mibbee leh! ella: nehi deen ochel metamme ochel middeorayyta, midderabbanan mihu metamme.
Hosif rabbi akiva: mimehen shel kohanim lo nimneu millehadlik kulei. mikkede shemen shennifsal bitvul yom may have — shelishi. vechi madlek leh bener shennitma bitme met may have — sheni.
May ka mashma lan — shelishi muttar laasoto sheni, hayeynu hach?! amar rav yehuda: hacha bener shel mattechet askinan, derachamana amar:
b: "Bachalal cherev". cherev hare hu kechalal. vehavya lay av hattumea, vekasavar shelishi muttar laasoto rishon.
Umay duchekeh derav yehuda leokmeh bener shel mattechet, nokmeh bener shel cheres,
Umay "hosif" — deillu hatam tame vetame, veillu hacha pasul vetame!
Amar rava, matnitin keshiteh: may irya detane ner shennitma bitme met? nitne shennitma besheretz!
Ella: ezehu davar shechaluka tumeato ben tumeat met lesheretz — heve omer ze mattechet.
Amar rava, shema minna kasavar rabbi akiva: tumeat mashkin letamme acherim deorayyta. dei salka datach derabbanan, mikkedi hay ner may ka mahneya lehay shemen, i leippesole gufeh — ha pesil vekae.
Mimmay? dilma letamme acherim midderabbanan. i midderabbanan, may irya beav hattumea? afillu berishon vesheni name techilla have!
Ditnan: kol happosel et hatteruma — metamme mashkin lihyot techilla, chutz mittevul yom.
Ella shema minna, deorayyta hi.
Amar rabbi meir middivrehem lamadnu vechulei. middivrehem deman? ilema middivre rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim, mi dame? hatam tame vetame, hacha tahor vetame!
Veella middivre rabbi akiva. mi dame? hatam pasul vetame, hacha tahor vetame!
Nema kasavar rabbi meir matnitin beav hattumea deorayyta vevlad hattumea derabbanan, demiddeorayyta tahor mealleya.

a: Umay "middivrehem" — middivre rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim.
Amar resh lakish mishshum bar kappara: matnitin beav hattumea deorayyta vevlad hattumea deorayyta, umay "middivrehem", middivre rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua.

He rabbi yehoshua? illema ha rabbi yehoshua ditnan: chavit shel teruma shennolad lah sefek tumea, rabbi eliezer omer: im hayta munnachat bimkom hatturepa, yannichenna bemakom hammutzena, veim hayta megulla — yechassenna.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: im hayta munnachat bemakom hammutzena — yannichenna bimkom hatturepa, veim hayta mechussa — yegallenna.
Mi dame? hatam — gerama bealma. hacha — beyadayim!
Ella ha rabbi yehoshua, ditnan: chavit shel teruma shennishbera baggat haelyona, vetachtona chullin temein,

Mode rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua sheim yachol lehatztzil mimmenna reviit betohora — yatztzil. veim lav, rabbi eliezer omer: tered vetittame, veal yetammeenna bayyad. rabbi yehoshua omer: af yetammeenna bayyad.
I hachi, hay "middivrehem", "middevarav" mibbee leh!
Hachi kaamar: mimmachloktan shel rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua lamadnu. dayka name: dekatane "mode rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua". shema minna.
Vechen amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu, matnitin beav hattumea deorayyta vevlad hattumea deorayyta. umay "middivrehem" — middivre rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua.

Etiveh rava lerav nachman, amar rabbi yose: en hannadon dome liraya, shekkesheheidu rabbotenu, al ma heidu — im al habbasar shennitma bivvlad hattumea shessorfin oto im habbasar shennitma beav hattumea, ze tame veze tame.

Im al hashshemen shennifsal bitvul yom shemmadlikin oto bener shennitma bitme met, ze pasul veze tame. af anu modim bitruma shennitmet bivvlad hattumea, shessorfin otah im hatteruma shennitmet beav hattumea.
Aval heach nisrof hatteluya im hattemea? shemma yavo eliyyahu vitaharenna!
b: Happiggul vehannotar vehattame — bet shammay omrim: en nisrafin keachat. uvet hillel omrim: nisrafin keachat.

Vei salka datach rabbi meir middivre rabbi yehoshua kaamar, ammay mahdar leh rabbi yose midderabbi chanina segan hakkohanim? amar leh rav nachman: rabbi yose lav addateh, dehu savar rabbi meir midderabbi chanina segan hakkohanim kaamar leh, vaamar leh: ana midderabbi yehoshua kaamena,
Vaamar leh: vaafillu lerabbi yehoshua name enah hi hammidda, deha mode rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua shessoref zo bifne atzmah vezo bifne atzmah.
Veammay enah hi hammidda? midda umidda hi!
Shane hatam, deikka hefsed chullin.
Matkef la rav yirmeya: matnitin name ikka hefsed deetzim! amar leh hahu sava: lehefsed merubbe — chashshu, lehefsed muat — lo chashshu.
Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: machaloket beshesh, aval besheva — divre hakkol sorfin.
Amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi assi: nema kasavar rabbi yochanan matnitin beav hattumea deorayyta vevlad hattumea derabbanan, umay "middivrehem" — middivre rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim.

Amar leh: in. ittemar name, amar rabbi yochanan: matnitin beav hattumea deorayyta vevlad hattumea derabbanan, umay "middivrehem" — middivre rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim. umachloket beshesh, aval besheva — divre hakkol sorfin.
Lema mesayyay leh: happiggul vehannotar vehattame, bet shammay omrim: en nisrafin keachat, uvet hillel omrim: nisrafin keachat.
Shane hatam: deit lehu tumea midderabbanan. ditnan: happiggul vehannotar metammein et hayyadayim.
Lema mesayyay leh: happat sheippesha venifsela milleechol leadam, vehakkelev yachol leochlah — metammea tumeat ochalin bichvetza, venisrefet im hattemea bappesach.
