Shane hatam, deafra bealma hu.
I hachi may mode? hachi kaamar leh rabbi yose lerabbi meir: afillu lerabbi yehoshua demekel, ki mekel — bitluya utemea, aval bithora utemea — la.
I hachi, ammay enah hi hammidda? midda umidda hi!
Amar rabbi yirmeya: hacha bevasar shennitma bemashkin shennitmeu mechamat sheretz, veazda rabbi meir letameh verabbi yose letameh.
Rabbi meir letameh, deamar: tumeat mashkin letamme acherim derabbanan.
Verabbi yose letameh, deamar: tumeat mashkin letamme acherim deorayyta. detanya:

a: Sefek mashkin littame — tame. letamme acherim — tahor, divre rabbi meir. vechen haya rabbi elazar omer kidvarav. rabbi yehuda omer: lakkol tame.
Rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim: laochalin temein, lechelim tehorin.

Vesavar rabbi elazar: mashkin it lehu tumea baolam? vehatanya, rabbi elazar omer: en tumea lemashkin kol ikkar. teda, shehare heid (yosef) ben yoezer ish tzereda al el kamtza dechan, veal mashkin bet matbechayya dechan!
Hanicha lishmuel, deamar dechan milletamme tumeat acherim, aval tumeat atzman yesh lahen — shappir. ella lerav, deamar dechan mammash — may ikka lememar?
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: achada.
Veha "kidvarav" kaamar, dinfishi. veod, veha "vechen" katane! kashya.

Gufa, rav amar: dechan mammash. ushemuel amar: dechan milletamme tumeat acherim, aval tumeat atzman yesh lahen. rav amar dechan mammash, kasavar tumeat mashkin derabbanan, vechi gezaru rabbanan — bemashkin dealma, uvemashkin bet matbechayya — la gezur.

Ushemuel amar: dechan milletamme tumeat acherim, aval tumeat atzman yesh lahen. kasavar tumeat mashkin atzman deorayyta, letamme acherim — derabbanan, vechi gezur rabbanan — bemashkin dealma, bemashkin bet matbechayya — la gezur. vechi la gezur rabbanan — letammoye acherim, aval tumeat atzman yesh lahen.

Amar leh rav huna bar chinnana livreh: ki ayylat lekammeh derav pappa, remi leh: mi amar shemuel dechan milletamme tumeat acherim, aval tumeat atzman yesh lahen? keri kan: "vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel".
Amar rav shisha bereh derav idi: midde dehave arvii bakkodesh. matkef la rav ashe: revii bakkodesh la ikkeri tame, hay ikkeri tame! kashya.
Ta shema: "vechol mashke asher yishshate bechol keli yitma"! may "yitma" — hechsher.
Hechsher — meresha dikra shamat leh, "mikkol haochel asher yeachel vegomer"! chad bitlushin, vechad bimchubbarin.
Utzerichi, dei ashmeinan bitlushin — mishshum deachshevinhu, aval mechubbarin — ema la.
Vei tena mechubbarin — mishshum dekayymi beduchetayyhu chashivi, aval telushin — ema la, tzerichi.
Ta shema: "ach mayan uvor mikve mayim yihye tahor". may "yihye tahor" — mittumeato.
Utelushin mi machshirin? vehaamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: mashkin bet matbechayya lo dayyayn shehen dechan, ella sheen machshirin.
Tayrgema al dam, deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: minnayin ledam kadashim sheeno machshir — shenneemar: "al haaretz tishpechennu kammayim", dam shennishpach kammayim — machshir,
b: Dam sheeno nishpach kammayim — eno machshir. matkef la rav shemuel bar amme: hare dam hattamtzit — denishpach kammayim, veeno machshir!
Amar leh rabbi zera: hannach ledam hattamtzit, daafillu bechullin name la machshir.
Kabbela minneh rav shemuel bar amme, deamar rachamana: "rak chazak levilti achol haddam ki haddam hu hannafesh", dam shehannefesh yotza bo — karuy dam, dam sheen hannefesh yotza bo — eno karuy dam.
Ta shema: dam shennitma uzerako, beshogeg — huretza, bemezid — lo huretza. midderabbanan, udela kerabbi yose ben yoezer ish tzereda.
Ta shema: al ma hatztzitz meratztze — al haddam veal habbasar veal hachelev shennitma, ben beshogeg ben bemezid, ben beones ben beratzon, ben beyachid ben betzibbur.
Midderabbanan, udela (keyosef) ben yoezer ish tzereda.
Ta shema: "venasa aharon et avon hakkodashim".
Vechi eze avon hu nose? im avon piggul — hare kevar neemar "lo yeratze". im avon notar — hare kevar neemar "lo yechashev".
Ha eno nose ella avon tumea shehuttera mikkelalah betzibbur. may lav, tumeat dam? amar rav pappa: la, tumeat kematzim.
Ta shema: "hen yissa ish besar kodesh bichnaf bigdo venaga bichnafo el hallechem veel hannazid veel hayyayin veel shemen veel kol maachol hayikdash vayyaanu hakkohanim vayyomru lo (yikdash)".

a: Veamar rav: ishtabbush kahane. midde hu tama ella lerav? rav "mashke bet matbechayya" tane, aval mashke be madbechayya — metamme.
Gufa, rav amar: ishtabbush kahane, ushemuel amar: la ishtabbush kahane.
Rav amar: ishtabbush kahane — revii bakkodesh bea minnayyhu, vaamaru leh tahor.
Vshmuel amar: la ishtabbush kahane — chamishi bakkodesh bea minnayyhu, vaamaru leh: tahor.
Bishlama lerav, hayeynu dichtiv arbea: lechem venazid veyayin vashemen. ella lishmuel, chamsha mena leh?
Mi ketiv "venaga kenafo"? "venaga bichnafo" ketiv — bema shennaga bichnafo.

Ta shema: "vayyomer chaggay im yigga teme nefesh bechol elle hayitma vayyaanu hakkohanim vayyomru yitma". bishlama lishmuel, middehacha la ishtabbush — hatam name la ishtabbush. ella lerav, may shena hacha deishtabbush, umay shena hatam dela ishtabbush?
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: bekiin hen betumeat met, veen bekiin hen betumeat sheretz.
Ravina amar: hatam revii, hacha shelishi.
Ta shema: "vayyaan chaggay vayyomer ken haam hazze vechen haggoy hazze lefanay neum Adonai vegomer". bishlama lerav, hayeynu dichtiv "tame". ella lishmuel, ammay tame?
Aytmohe ka matma. veha "vechen kol maase yedehem" ketiv! amar mar zutera veittema rav ashe: mittoch shekkilkelu et maasehem — maale alehem hakkatuv keillu hikrivu betumea.
Gufa. rav tane "mashke bet matbechayya", velevi tane "mashke be madbechayya".
Lelevi, hanicha i sevira leh kishmuel, deamar: "dechan" milletamme tumeat acherim aval tumeat atzman yesh lahen — mashkachat la denagi kullehu berishon.
Ella i savar leh kerav, deamar: "dechan" mammash — hechi mashkachat lah? al korchach kishmuel sevira leh.
Velishmuel, hanicha i savar la kerav, detane: "mashke bet matbechayya" aval mashke be madbechayya — acharine name meytammeu, revii hu dela aved chamishi, ha shelishi — aved revii.
Ella i savar leh kelevi, detane: "mashke be madbechayya", may irya revii dela aved chamishi? afillu sheni ushelishi name la avdi! al korchaych kerav sevira leh.

Tanya kevoteh derav, tanya kevoteh delevi. tanya kevoteh delevi: haddam vehayyayin vehashshemen vehammayim, mashke be madbechayya shennitmeu bifnim vehotzian lachutz — tehorin. nitmeu bachutz vehichnisan bifnim — temein.
Ini?! vehaamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: mashke be madbechayya lo amru dechan ella bimkoman. may lav — lemaote nitmeu bifnim vehotzian lachutz! la, lemaote nitmeu bachutz vehichnisan bifnim.
Veha "bimkoman" kaamar! hachi kaamar: lo amru dechan — ella shennitmeu bimkoman.
Tanya kevoteh derav: haddam vehammayim mashke bet matbechayya shennitmeu ben bechelim ben bekarka — tehorin.
b: (Rabban) shimon omer: bechelim temein, bekarka tehorin.

Amar rav pappa: afillu leman deamar tumeat mashkin deorayyta — mashke bet matbechayya hilcheta gemiri la. amar leh rav huna bereh derav natan lerav pappa: veella ha deamar rabbi eliezer: en tumea lemashkin kol ikkar, teda, shehare heid (yosef) ben yoezer ish tzereda al mashke bet matbechayya dechan.
Vei hilcheta gemiri la — mi gamrinan minna?
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: veha rabbi shimon deamar tumeat mashkin deorayyta, detanya: rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim: lechelim tehorin, laochalin temein.
Vehacha kaamar (rabban) shimon: bechelim temein, bekarka tehorin. vei hilcheta hi, ma li bechelim ma li bekarka? kashya.
Amar rav pappa: ha deamrat bekarka tehorin — lo shanu ella mayim, aval dam — lo.
Umayim name la amaran ella dehave reviit, dechaze lehatebil beh mechatin vetzinnorot. aval la have reviit — temein.
Amar mar, rabbi yehuda omer: lakkol tame. lememra desavar rabbi yehuda tumeat mashkin letamme tumeat kelim deorayyta?
Vehatnan: kol hakkelim sheyyesh lahen achorayim vatoch, kegon hakkarim vehakkesatot vehassakkin vehammartzufin, nitma tocho — nitma gabbo, nitma gabbo — lo nitma tocho.
Amar rabbi yehuda: bamme devarim amurim — shennitmeu mechamat mashkin, aval nitmeu mechamat sheretz, nitma tocho — nitma gabbo, nitma gabbo — nitma tocho.
Vei salka datach tumeat mashkin letamme kelim deorayyta, ma li nitma mechamat mashkin, ma li nitma mechamat sheretz? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: chazar bo rabbi yehuda.
Ravina amar: leolam la hadar, ha — bemashkin habbain mechamat yadayim. ha — bemashkin habbain mechamat sheretz.

I hachi, addetane "bamme devarim amurim shennitmeu mechamat mashkin", liflog velitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim — bemashkin habbain mechamat yadayim. aval bemashkin habbain mechamat sheretz, nitma tocho — nitma gabbo, nitma gabbo — nitma tocho! ella mechavvavrta kidshannin meikkara: chazar bo rabbi yehuda.
Ibbaya lehu: mikkelim hu dahadar beh, aval baochalin kerabbi yose verabbi shimon sevira leh. o dilma: ligmare hadar beh kerabbi meir?
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, ta shema: para sheshshatta me chattat — besarah tame. rabbi yehuda omer:

a: Batlu bemeeha. vei salka datach mikkelim hu dahadar beh, aval baochalin kerabbi yose verabbi shimon sevira leh, ammay batlu bemeeha ligmare?
Nehi detumea chamura la metammeu, tumea kalla miha nitammeu!
May "batlu bemeeha" name? batlu mittumea chamura, aval tumea kalla metammeu. mikkelal detanna kamma savar: tumea chamura name metammeu, ha "besarah tame" katane!

Kulle rabbi yehuda hi, vechassore michassera, vehachi katane: para sheshshatta me chattat — besarah tame. bamme devarim amurim — tumea kalla, aval tumea chamura — lo, sherabbi yehuda omer: batlu bemeeha.
Rav ashe amar: leolam batlu bemeeha ligmare, mishshum dehave leh mashke saruach.
Rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim: laochalin — temein, lechelim — tehorim. amar rabba bar bar chana amar resh lakish: rabbi yose beshitat rabbi akiva rabbo amarah, dedaresh "yitma" — yetamme.
Ditnan, bo bayyom darash rabbi akiva: "vechol keli cheres asher yippol mehem vegomer", eno omer "tame" ella "yitma" — yetamme acherim, limmed al kikkar sheni sheose shelishi bechullin.
Vehacha hechi daresh? "vechol mashke asher yishshate bechol keli yitma" — yetamme, letamme tumeat ochalin. atta omer letamme tumeat ochalin, o eno ella letamme tumeat mashkin? amarta: lo kach haya.
May "lo kach haya"? amar rav pappa: la matzinu tumea sheosa kayyotze bah.

Ravina amar: miggufeh dikra name la matzet amrat "yitma" — letamme tumeat mashkin. dei salka datach "yitma" desefa letamme tumeat mashkin, "yitma" deresha, name letamme tumeat mashkin. niarvinhu venichtevinhu: "mikkol haochel asher yeachel asher yavo alav mayim vechol mashke asher yishshate bechol keli yitma".
Tere "yitma" lema li? ella: "yitma" deresha letamme tumeat mashkin, "yitma" desefa letamme tumeat ochalin.
Veema letamme et hakkelim! velav kal vachomer hu, uma keli shemmetamme mashke — en metamme keli, mashkin habbain mechamat keli — eno din shello yetammeu et hakkelim?
Veema: ki la metammeu, mashkin habbain mechamat keli. aval mashkin habbain mechamat sheretz, hachi name dimtammeu! mashkin habbain mechamat sheretz mi ketivi?
b: Velav mikkal vachomer kaate: uma mashkin habbain mechamat keli — metammein, mashkin habbain mechamat sheretz — lo kol shekken!
Dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon.
"Yitma" deresha hechi daresh? "mikkol haochel asher yeachel asher yavo alav mayim yitma", yitma — letamme et hammashkin. atta omer letamme et hammashkin, o eno ella letamme et hakkeli?

Amarta kal vachomer: uma mashke shemmetamme ochel — eno metamme keli, ochel sheen metamme ochel — eno din shello yetamme keli?! ha ma ani mekayyem "yitma" — letamme et hammashkin shehen alulin lekabbel tumea.
May irya mashkin mishshum daalulin lekabbel tumea, tippok leh mishshum delekka midde acharina!
Hachi kaamar: vechi tema ochel chamur, dimtamme mashkin, nitammeyeh lichli. hahu chumera demashkin hu, mishshum demashkin alulin lekabbel tumea.
Uma hi alilatan — shemmekabbelin tumea shello behechsher.

"Yitma" — deen osa kayyotze bah, mehacha nafka? mehatam nafka: "vechi yuttan mayim al zera venafal minnivlatam alav tame hu" — hu tame, veen ose tumea kayyotze bah! chad bemashkin habbain mechamat sheretz, vechad bemashkin habbain mechamat keli.
Utzerichi? dei ashmoinan bemashkin habbain mechamat keli — mishshum dela chamiri. aval bemashkin habbain mechamat sheretz — dachamiri, ema ose tumea kayyotze bah.
Velashmeinan mashkin habbain mechamat sheretz, vechol shekken mashkin habbain mechamat keli! milleta deatya bekal vachomer tarach vechatev la kera.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: veha amar rava: la rabbi yose savar kerabbi akiva,
Vela rabbi akiva savar kerabbi yose!
Amar leh: rabbi yose beshitat rabbi akiva rabbo amarah, veleh la sevira leh.
Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana: bishlama rabbi yose la savar la kerabbi akiva, detanya: amar rabbi yose: minnayin larvii bakkodesh shehu pasul?
Vedin hu: uma mechussar kippurim shemmuttar bitruma, pasul bakkodesh. shelishi sheppasul bitruma — eno din sheyyaase revii bakkodesh?
Velamadnu shelishi bakkodesh min hattora, urevii mikkal vachomer.
Shelishi min hattora, dichtiv "vehabbasar asher yigga
